source_doc:
The Case for Impeaching Donald Trump

Bombs over Latin America: It's giving Wag the Dog, if you ask me. The administration, seemingly hot to bring back neoconservative military conquest, soft-launched its latest regime change war in Venezuela by making indiscriminate attacks on boats in the Caribbean and Pacific waters off of Central America. These attacks, all undertaken without a jot of congressional oversight and on the dubious premise that the boats were packed with fentanyl bound for the United States, were murderous on their own. But the news that the military was ordered to strike an already stricken boat in a "double tap" attack to kill any survivors has raised the specter of war crimes - and in a way that even many Republicans don't seem ready to countenance.

Trump's Binance buddy gets a pardon: Changpeng Zhao began this year the disgraced former CEO of Binance, the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange, having done prison time for, as the Biden DOJ put it, "failing to maintain an effective anti-money laundering (AML) program," violating the Bank Security Act, and allowing money to flow freely to a host of bad actors, including "terrorists, cybercriminals, and child abusers." But Zhao, having forfeited the right to run Binance, wanted back in. So he used his connections to Trump's family and inner circle to secure a pardon that would let him run the show again. In return, Zhao showered his attention on World Liberty Financial - using Binance's leverage to enrich Trump's private crypto fund. TNR's Tim Noah was positively apoplectic about the shady arrangement.

Chips to China: Speaking of Tim Noah and apoplexy: It's probably not great that one firm, Nvidia, has come to possess such godlike, market-moving power. Its outsize importance to the global economy had Noah fingering it as one of the major pillars to crumble, when he gamed out a potential Trump stock market crash back in October. Trump's been doing what he can to boost Nvidia's fortunes, however: This year, the president broke with long-standing national security tradition and announced that he was permitting the firm to sell its H200 chips to China. As The New York Times" David Sanger noted, the deal - the fruits of "intense lobbying" from Nvidia CEO and White House gadfly Jensen Huang - raised a basic question: "If the chips that power the most advanced technology can be sold to the United States" chief technological, military and financial competitor, where is the new line drawn?" That's probably the least of Trump's concerns, however: The deal also guaranteed that "25 percent of all the revenues from the sales would go to the United States," in yet another case of this administration's affection for fascist corporatism.

hypothesis:
Alasan untuk Memakzulkan Donald Trump

Bom di Amerika Latin: Menurut saya, ini mengingatkan pada Wag the Dog. Pemerintahan ini, yang tampaknya bernafsu menghidupkan kembali ekspansi militer neokonservatif, diam-diam memulai perang perubahan rezim terbarunya di Venezuela dengan melancarkan serangan membabi buta terhadap kapal-kapal di perairan Karibia dan Pasifik lepas pantai Amerika Tengah. Serangan-serangan itu, yang seluruhnya dilakukan tanpa secuil pun pengawasan Kongres dan dengan dalih meragukan bahwa kapal-kapal tersebut sarat fentanyl untuk dikirim ke Amerika Serikat, pada dirinya sendiri sudah bersifat mematikan. Namun kabar bahwa militer diperintahkan untuk menyerang kembali sebuah kapal yang sudah lebih dulu dihantam, dalam serangan "double tap" untuk membunuh siapa pun yang selamat, telah memunculkan bayang-bayang kejahatan perang—dan dengan cara yang tampaknya bahkan banyak anggota Partai Republik pun enggan membenarkannya.

Kawan Trump di Binance mendapat pengampunan: Changpeng Zhao memulai tahun ini sebagai mantan CEO Binance, bursa kripto terbesar di dunia, yang tercoreng setelah menjalani hukuman penjara karena, sebagaimana dikatakan Departemen Kehakiman AS pada era Biden, "gagal mempertahankan program anti-pencucian uang (AML) yang efektif", melanggar Undang-Undang Kerahasiaan Bank, dan membiarkan uang mengalir bebas kepada berbagai pelaku jahat, termasuk "teroris, penjahat siber, dan pelaku pelecehan anak." Namun Zhao, setelah kehilangan hak untuk menjalankan Binance, ingin kembali berkuasa. Karena itu, ia memanfaatkan hubungannya dengan keluarga dan lingkaran dalam Trump untuk memperoleh pengampunan yang akan memungkinkannya kembali mengendalikan perusahaan itu. Sebagai imbalannya, Zhao mengucurkan perhatiannya kepada World Liberty Financial—memanfaatkan pengaruh Binance untuk memperkaya dana kripto pribadi Trump. Tim Noah dari TNR benar-benar murka atas pengaturan gelap tersebut.

Chip ke China: Berbicara tentang Tim Noah dan amarahnya: barangkali bukan pertanda baik bahwa satu perusahaan, Nvidia, telah memiliki kekuatan yang nyaris bak dewa dalam menggerakkan pasar. Arti pentingnya yang sangat besar bagi perekonomian global membuat Noah menunjuknya sebagai salah satu pilar utama yang bisa runtuh ketika ia memetakan potensi kejatuhan pasar saham akibat Trump pada Oktober lalu. Namun Trump telah melakukan apa yang ia bisa untuk mendongkrak nasib Nvidia: tahun ini, presiden itu menyimpang dari tradisi lama keamanan nasional dan mengumumkan bahwa ia mengizinkan perusahaan tersebut menjual chip H200-nya ke China. Seperti dicatat David Sanger dari The New York Times, kesepakatan itu—buah dari "lobi intensif" CEO Nvidia sekaligus pengganggu tetap Gedung Putih, Jensen Huang—menimbulkan pertanyaan mendasar: "Jika chip yang menopang teknologi paling canggih dapat dijual kepada pesaing utama Amerika Serikat dalam bidang teknologi, militer, dan keuangan, di mana garis batas baru ditarik?" Namun itu barangkali justru kekhawatiran Trump yang paling kecil: kesepakatan itu juga menjamin bahwa "25 persen dari seluruh pendapatan penjualan akan masuk ke Amerika Serikat", dalam satu lagi contoh kegemaran pemerintahan ini terhadap korporatisme fasis.

Seperti dicatat David Sanger dari The New York Times, kesepakatan itu—buah dari "lobi intensif" CEO Nvidia sekaligus pengganggu tetap Gedung Putih, Jensen Huang—menimbulkan pertanyaan mendasar: "Jika chip yang menopang teknologi paling canggih dapat dijual kepada pesaing utama Amerika Serikat dalam bidang teknologi, militer, dan keuangan, di mana garis batas baru ditarik?" Namun itu barangkali justru kekhawatiran Trump yang paling kecil: kesepakatan itu juga menjamin bahwa "25 persen dari seluruh pendapatan penjualan akan masuk ke Amerika Serikat", dalam satu lagi contoh kegemaran pemerintahan ini terhadap korporatisme fasis.

On a lighter note, just saw someone complaining about when games beg you to switch to easy mode when you fail.
I also hate this.
I love having an easy mode. Hell, I think games should just fuckin' let you cheat, as long as competitions all have agreed-on rules about it.
But every game that's pestered me into easy mode has been an instant put-down. I have plenty of games to play, if you want me to be done faster, congrats, I'm done faster.

This is what makes modern Marios - modern-ish anyway - so impossible for me to play.
"Did you die thwee times mawwio? Here's the golden supersuit of invincibility because you suck! If you don't want it, just carefully avoid ever pressing anything besides "start level yes again no no nothing else just start the level".
This is also why I stopped trying to play Phantom Pain. Whenever I died, it'd offer me the chicken hat and default to "yes", eventually I forgot to manually say "fuck off".

I get it's a retention thing, but it's so disrespectful.
Autoscaling difficulty also pisses me off, because I'll be gearing up for a challenge and then the game will panic and lower it to super easy because I've been "struggling".
I'll die or something, go back to try again, but nope, now the challenge is gone. You succeeded! You made the game go away! Don't worry, those challenges were for someone else. Someone better.
I can't remember if I ever completed a game with autoscaling difficulty.

I guess the basic difference between me and their target audience is that I like to figure out how to do something, while their target audience - at least in their heads - likes to take a log flume through a Disneyworld attraction.
A little jostling, a little fluids, but don't worry, baby, daddy Walt's got ya. You're safey-wafe, you don't even have to move, just sit there and tee hee, here's a wittle splashy-splash.
If I wanted that, I'd go sit in a fucking dog park and pet a dog.

Oiya, ngomong-ngomong, gue baru aja lihat ada yang ngeluh soal game yang ngebujuk kita buat ganti ke mode gampang pas kita kalah.
Gue juga benci banget nih yang begini.
Gue seneng sih ada mode gampang. Malah menurut gue, game harusnya bebasin aja pemainnya buat ngecheat, selama di kompetisi resmi ada aturan yang disepakatin soal itu.
Tapi semua game yang maksa gue buat masuk ke mode gampang langsung gue matiin saat itu juga. Game gue masih banyak yang bisa dimainin, jadi kalau emang mau gue kelar lebih cepet, selamat deh, gue emang kelar lebih cepet.

Ini nih yang bikin game-game Mario modern—atau ya yang lumayan baru lah—jadi malesin banget buat dimainin.
"Kamu mati tiga kali ya, Mawwio? Nih, pake baju super emas anti-mati karena kamu payah! Kalau gak mau pake, ya musti ati-ati banget biar gak kepencet apa pun selain 'mulai level ya lagi gak gak gak yang lain pokoknya mulai level aja'."
Ini juga alasan kenapa gue gak lanjut main Phantom Pain. Tiap kali mati, game-nya selalu nawarin topi ayam dan otomatis milih "ya", sampe akhirnya gue lupa buat ngeklik "ogah".

Gue paham sih ini biar pemain gak bosen dan kabur, tapi kok rasanya gak ngehargain banget ya.
Tingkat kesulitan yang otomatis berubah sendiri juga bikin gue emosi, soalnya pas gue lagi siap-siap buat ngadepin tantangan, eh game-nya malah panik dan nurunin tingkat kesulitannya jadi gampang banget cuma gara-gara gue kelihatan "kesulitan".
Pas gue mati atau gimana gitu, terus mau coba lagi, eh tantangannya udah ilang. Lu berhasil! Lu bikin game-nya ilang! Tenang aja, tantangan tadi itu buat orang lain kok. Buat orang yang lebih jago.
Gue bahkan lupa apa pernah namatin game yang tingkat kesulitannya otomatis berubah sendiri.

Kayaknya perbedaan mendasar antara gue sama target pasar mereka adalah gue suka nyari tahu cara nyelesein sesuatu, sedangkan target pasar mereka—seenggaknya di pikiran mereka—itu sukanya duduk manis nikmatin wahana air di Disneyworld.
Ada goyangan dikit, kecipratan dikit, tapi tenang aja sayang, papi Walt bakal jagain kamu. Kamu aman kok, gak usah ngapa-ngapain, tinggal duduk manis aja sambil ketawa-ketiwi pas kecipratan air dikit.
Kalau gue pengen yang kayak gitu, mending gue pergi ke taman anjing terus ngelus-ngelus anjing sekalian.

This morning while walking to work I had a thought: is it possible that the reason why the perception of the #replyGuy problem being worse on #Mastodon (and the #Fediverse in general) is due to sheer (lack of) numbers?
So I came up with a simplified model to check if this was indeed sufficient to explain the phenomenon.

I just had a very nice #dream that I made friends with Lee Chaeyeon. I just started talking to her nand the next thing I know, I have stayed over her house (like when the French kidnapped me for Christmas) and she is telling me to go up stairs and "shuffle up a little bit" (her English was generally excellent) by which she meant "tidy up a little bit" to show her mom we were ready to eat.
She comes upstairs to "shuffle up" her room and starts making gestures to explain what she means ...
1/

(she was always so excited to see me in this dream) because I was taking my coat off instead of "shuffling up."
Then she indicates this little piece of paper and says she has left me an autograph but in return she wants this little trading card I made in second grade of "50 Spikes," a sonic knock-off, obviously with more spikes. (This card actually exists IRL BTW). I start explaining to her what it is and if she really wants it (she did) I at least needed a picture of her holding it.
2/

Partly because I would miss it, but also, otherwise no one would believe me that she had wanted this thing from me.
It was then I realized we still didn't have each others' phone numbers.
3/3

"An utterly miserable day": Kempton Park meeting marred by death of three horses

The Lanzarote Hurdle card at Kempton Park was marred by the death of three horses, including the Grade One-winning Kalif Du Berlais, whose loss Paul Nicholls described as "a big kick in the teeth" and a "sad day."

Kalif Du Berlais - whose ownership group includes Sir Alex Ferguson - unseated Harry Cobden in the four-runner Coral Silviniaco Conti Chase and landed lame, with the broken shoulder he sustained proving untreatable and he was euthanised by the veterinary team on Saturday.

Nicholls said: "It's a sad day when you lose horses like that, it's hard on the whole team. It's a big kick in the teeth for everyone, the owners, the poor girl who looks after him - you hate to see that happen. He was just showing his class today, he jumped and travelled well and sadly now he will never be able to show the potential we thought he had.

"I can say as much as I like, but it's just a shame for the whole team. Harry was extremely upset and is missing his ride in the last as he doesn't feel great about it. He's a big, bold horse who attacks his fences and those horses, when they do that, can end up having a bad fall.

"He was enthusiastic today and travelling beautifully and we'll never know where we would have ended up, we've always had a lot of faith in him. These things happen, sadly, and we'll have to try to pick ourselves up and move forward. These horses get the best of everything, there's not much you can say to make it better at this point.

"It never gets any easier when these things happen and it's a big old blow."

In the Coral Daily Rewards Shaker Handicap Chase, Jonjo and AJ O'Neill's Peso was pulled up on the flat with an injury that could not be treated, leaving racecourse vets with no choice but to euthanise him.

Harry Derham saddled Wertpol for the juvenile hurdle and the horse looked to be running a huge race before falling at the last and sustaining a life-ending injury. Derham said on his X account: "An utterly miserable day at Kempton Park today losing Wertpol who we only had the good fortune of having in our yard for a short period of time.

"It's a sad day when you lose horses like that, it's hard on the whole team. It's a big kick in the teeth for everyone," said Paul Nicholls. Photograph: Alan Crowhurst/Getty Images

"He was a bright talent who was fresh and happy doing his work every day, often playing around and expressing himself. He loved his job and I am so sad for his Heart Of The South syndicate, who are the most wonderful group of people. Racing can at times be a painful sport and today has been a tough day for a number of connections. A day to forget."

A spokesperson for Kempton Park said: "All of us at Kempton Park care deeply about the welfare of all racehorses, as do the thousands of racing staff who provide them with world-class levels of care at home every day. Our heartfelt condolences are with the connections of all three horses."

hypothesis:
"Hari yang benar-benar kelam": Gelaran balap Kempton Park dinodai kematian tiga ekor kuda

Rangkaian balapan Lanzarote Hurdle di Kempton Park dinodai oleh kematian tiga ekor kuda, termasuk pemenang Kelas Satu Kalif Du Berlais, yang kehilangannya digambarkan oleh Paul Nicholls sebagai "pukulan telak" dan "hari yang menyedihkan."

Kalif Du Berlais — yang kepemilikannya juga melibatkan Sir Alex Ferguson — menjatuhkan joki Harry Cobden dalam laga Coral Silviniaco Conti Chase yang diikuti empat peserta dan mendarat dalam kondisi pincang. Cedera patah bahu yang dialaminya terbukti tidak dapat disembuhkan, sehingga ia akhirnya disuntik mati oleh tim medis hewan pada hari Sabtu.

Nicholls mengatakan: "Hari yang menyedihkan ketika Anda harus kehilangan kuda-kuda seperti itu, ini sangat berat bagi seluruh tim. Ini adalah pukulan telak bagi semua orang: para pemilik, hingga gadis malang yang merawatnya — Anda tentu benci melihat hal ini terjadi. Dia baru saja menunjukkan kelasnya hari ini, melompat dan melaju dengan baik, namun sayangnya kini dia tidak akan pernah bisa membuktikan potensi besar yang kami yakini ada pada dirinya.

"Saya bisa bicara apa saja, tetapi ini tetap merupakan pukulan bagi seluruh tim. Harry sangat terpukul dan melewatkan balapan terakhirnya karena perasaannya sedang tidak karuan. Dia adalah kuda yang besar dan berani yang selalu menerjang rintangan, dan kuda-kuda seperti itu, ketika melakukannya, bisa berakhir mengalami jatuh yang fatal.

"Hari ini dia tampil penuh semangat dan berlari dengan sangat indah. Kita tidak akan pernah tahu seberapa jauh pencapaian yang bisa diraihnya, padahal kami selalu menaruh kepercayaan besar padanya. Sayangnya, hal-hal seperti ini bisa terjadi, dan kami harus mencoba bangkit dan terus melangkah maju. Kuda-kuda ini selalu mendapatkan perawatan terbaik, tidak banyak yang bisa dikatakan untuk meredakan kesedihan saat ini.

"Kejadian seperti ini tidak pernah terasa lebih mudah untuk diterima dan ini merupakan hantaman yang sangat berat."

Dalam Coral Daily Rewards Shaker Handicap Chase, kuda milik Jonjo dan AJ O'Neill, Peso, terpaksa dihentikan di lintasan datar akibat cedera yang tidak dapat diobati, sehingga tim dokter hewan sirkuit tidak memiliki pilihan lain selain menyuntik matinya.

Harry Derham melatih Wertpol untuk laga rintangan remaja dan kuda tersebut tampak sedang berlari sangat apik sebelum akhirnya terjatuh di rintangan terakhir dan mengalami cedera fatal. Derham menulis di akun X miliknya: "Hari yang benar-benar kelam di Kempton Park hari ini karena kami harus kehilangan Wertpol, yang baru sebentar saja kami miliki di kandang kami.

"Hari yang menyedihkan ketika Anda harus kehilangan kuda-kuda seperti itu, ini sangat berat bagi seluruh tim. Ini adalah pukulan telak bagi semua orang," kata Paul Nicholls. Foto: Alan Crowhurst/Getty Images

"Dia adalah bakat yang luar biasa, selalu bugar dan gembira saat berlatih setiap hari, sering bermain-main dan mengekspresikan dirinya. Dia sangat mencintai perannya dan saya sangat terpukul untuk sindikat Heart Of The South pemiliknya, yang merupakan kelompok orang-orang yang luar biasa. Balapan adakalanya bisa menjadi olahraga yang menyakitkan dan hari ini adalah hari yang berat bagi sejumlah pihak yang terlibat. Sebuah hari yang ingin kami lupakan."

Seorang juru bicara Kempton Park menyatakan: "Kami semua di Kempton Park sangat peduli dengan kesejahteraan setiap kuda pacu, begitu pula ribuan staf pacuan yang memberikan perawatan standar dunia untuk mereka di kandang setiap hari. Belasungkawa terdalam kami sampaikan kepada semua pihak yang terkait dengan ketiga kuda tersebut."

Progress after a while off. I got the sewing machine out to do the bill and a crown seam. Half the crown sewn plus the bill, resting atop the paper form made from the pattern. I had to rip and re-sew the machine stitch because I pinned along instead of across the seam and went off track. I might re-do the bill if I want a little more depth.
#millinery

Eight crown panels and two bill panels assembled into three pieces and pinned for general shape. Sachi's Studio Newsboy Cap pattern in green velvet. Mostly machine stitched.
The pattern calls for topstitching along the seams of the crown panels, which might suggest either matching or contrasting thread.
#millinery

Top view before I sew the crown halves together. Reviewing the how-to video. I see Sachi is using a few tiny spring clips during sewing instead of pinning the whole seam.

A bit of a messy join on the eight panels coming together at the peak of the newsboy cap, so I am thinking a larger button may be in order to disguise the seams.

Crown fully pieced, with cloth covered.button at peak. Raw edges loosely tucked under. Seams neither pressed nor topstitched.
#millinery

Reading Gloria Steinem's undercover report on being a Playboy Bunny... finished Part I and damn🤔
Despite being well aware of Playboy being uh... a CORPORATION lol... had no idea how much their entire infrastructure truly served to perpetuate classism in an extremely creepy way while outwardly presenting themselves as the "classy" and thus "more ethical" option compared to say, Hustler

I'll post some screenshots later but to give you the gist, Bunnies (who were cocktail waitresses), had to:
- accept lower (by $200-150, equivalent to today's $2.5K) wages than advertised
- hand over 50% of all their tips
- give their last names to "Number 1 key holders" (ergo, celebrities/elites) if asked
- be subjected to a pelvic exam and blood test but weren't allowed to pick the physician
- be spied on by a private eye
- go out if their way to hide their husbands/bfs

The central point that unites all of this:
Bunnies were STRICTLY NOT ALLOWED TO (penalized by termination) date any other employees or customers... BUT accompanying and dating the "Number 1 key holders" was permitted, if not encouraged. See where this is going?

New recruits were given a "Bunny Bible" to study all those bizarre rules and instructions from.
To mention a few more:
- Bunnies' work performance was assessed by a "merit system" (YES, that exact wording!) instead of being written up. Unsurprisingly, merit was not only judged by a good work ethic but also very specific requirements on looks and attitude.
- there was an incentive system in place that rewarded Bunnies who sold the most liquor and merchandise

Walaupun gue udah paham banget kalau Playboy itu ya... sebuah KORPORASI lol... gue bener-bener nggak nyangka kalau seluruh infrastruktur mereka ternyata segitunya dipakai buat melanggengkan klasisisme dengan cara yang super creepy, sambil di luarnya ngejual citra sebagai opsi yang “berkelas” dan karena itu “lebih etis” dibanding, misalnya, Hustler

Nanti gue bakal post beberapa screenshot, tapi biar kebayang garis besarnya, para Bunny (yang kerja sebagai pramusaji koktail) harus:
- nerima gaji yang lebih rendah ($150-200 lebih kecil, setara sekitar $2.5K sekarang) dari yang diiklankan
- nyerahin 50% dari semua tip mereka
- ngasih nama belakang mereka ke “pemegang kunci Nomor 1” (alias selebritas/kaum elite) kalau diminta
- menjalani pemeriksaan panggul dan tes darah, tapi nggak boleh milih dokternya sendiri
- dimata-matai detektif swasta
- mati-matian nyembunyiin suami/pacar mereka

Benang merah dari semua ini:
Para Bunny SAMA SEKALI NGGAK BOLEH (kalau melanggar hukumannya dipecat) pacaran sama pegawai lain atau pelanggan... TAPI nemenin dan ngedate sama “pemegang kunci Nomor 1” itu dibolehin, kalau bukan malah didorong. Kelihatan kan ini arahnya ke mana?

Rekrutan baru dikasih “Bunny Bible” buat dipelajari, yang isinya semua aturan dan instruksi aneh itu.
Buat nyebut beberapa lagi:
- performa kerja para Bunny dinilai lewat “sistem merit” (IYA, redaksinya persis begitu!) alih-alih dikasih teguran tertulis. Nggak heran, “merit” di sini bukan cuma dinilai dari etos kerja yang bagus, tapi juga dari syarat yang sangat spesifik soal penampilan dan sikap.
- ada sistem insentif yang ngasih penghargaan buat para Bunny yang paling banyak jual minuman keras dan merchandise

while watching i wondered why the earth needed to be in peril, and if the other two members of the multicultural crew dying to leave the White Man in charge was some kind of an anti-woke statement; but in light of some of the book author andy weir's 'most media literate libertarian' comments about how star trek should be just about spaceships going pew-pew, at least to him the answer is yes to the latter and 'fascism' to the former

@esvrld I read the book a little while back and I may have given him too much credit, especially given his recent decision to open his mouth, but I took the death of the international crew to strand the white boy as an understanding that his second book failed because he is not any good at writing people interacting with each other and his only skill is creating clever little puzzles for his self-insert to solve in complete isolation. Giving him an alien buddy was a good move because it opens the possibility of character interaction without requiring it to resemble the way humans relate to one another

The hosts took the lead in the 26th minute via the prolific Diaz as the Real Madrid player showed his scoring instinct.

Achraf Hakimi's corner was headed goalwards by Ayoub El Kaabi and Diaz deflected the ball in from close range.

He has now scored in each of Morocco's five games and extends his own record for most goals by a Moroccan at a single Cup of Nations finals, but left the field late on with a heavily strapped thigh that will be a concern for coach Walid Regragui.

Chances were hard to come by for both sides, but Abde Ezzalzouli headed narrowly over the crossbar from another Hakimi corner, while the latter laid on a headed chance for Saibari that was spurned.

Cameroon were unfortunate not to get a penalty kick when Mbeumo was caught in the box as Mauritanian referee Dahane Beida waved play on, while Georges-Kevin Nkoudou headed wide at the back post with the Indomitable Lions' best chance of the game.

Morocco made it 2-0 minutes later to kill off the contest when Saibari was left unmarked at the back post and had time to control the ball and fire low into the far corner of the net.

Ismael Saibari gave Morocco breathing space against Cameroon (REUTERS)

In Friday's other quarter-final, Iliman Ndiaye scored the only goal as Senegal booked an Afcon semi-final berth for the third time in the last four tournaments, beating 10-man Mali 1-0.

Ndiaye netted after 27 minutes, taking advantage of a goalkeeping howler to put Senegal ahead in a tense derby against their west African neighbours.

Mali were reduced to 10 men for the second half after captain Yves Bissouma was sent off for a second caution on the stroke of halftime.

He was booked first for a clumsy challenge in the 25th minute and was dismissed after a needless foul on Idrissa Gana Gueye.

Mali were down to 10 men from the 26th minute of their previous clash against Tunisia and still managed to squeeze through on penalties but there was no recovery this time around against a polished Senegalese outfit.

Ia kini selalu mencetak gol dalam kelima pertandingan yang dijalani Maroko dan memperpanjang rekor pribadinya sebagai pencetak gol terbanyak dari Maroko dalam satu putaran final Piala Afrika, meski ia harus ditarik keluar menjelang akhir laga dengan paha dibebat tebal yang tentu memicu kecemasan bagi pelatih Walid Regragui.

Local stable out to cash in at Coffs with four contenders

Local trainer Noel Mayfield-Smith is hoping to have a lucrative day at Sunday's Coffs Harbour meeting with four runners stepping out for the stable on the six-race card.

The Group 1-winning horseman will start his day in the second event of the day when Ausbred Yahoo contests the Komatsu Country Boosted Benchmark 58 Handicap (1605m) with two-kilogram claiming apprentice Ella Drew taking the ride.

Racing returns to Coffs Harbour on Sunday.

Ausbred Yahoo has been racing in good form with a third placing at Kempsey three starts ago being followed by two successive seconds at Coffs Harbour, the latest when beaten by Sunday's rival Caledonian.

Mayfield-Smith links with another apprentice, three-kilogram claimer Leanne Boyd, when Never Island starts in the Insurance Advisernet Australia Pink Silks F&M Benchmark 58 Handicap (1305m).

A winner of three of her 15 starts, Never Island will carry 59.5 kilograms after Boyd's allowance. Never Island was beaten less than a length when second behind Montgomery at Grafton and backed that up with a last-start fifth at Coffs Harbour behind In The Fine Print when again beaten less than a length.

Raymond Spokes takes the ride on the Mayfield-Smith-prepared Monte Cruise in the O'Brien Plumbing Relining Wayne Glenn Pink Silks Cup Benchmark 82 Handicap (1205m).

Monte Cruise is also a three-time winner from just the nine starts. She hasn't raced since July when finishing last of eight at Eagle Farm and has had two trials at this track in preparation for her return, finishing second behind Saturday's Wyong winner Petticoat before winning the latest of them.

Mayfield-Smith rounds out the day when he again links with Boyd when she rides Cardsharp in the Key Community Group C,G&E Benchmark 58 Handicap (1305m).

Pelatih lokal Noel Mayfield-Smith berharap dapat meraup keuntungan besar pada hari Minggu di Coffs Harbour dengan menurunkan empat kuda dari kandangnya dalam program yang menyajikan enam balapan tersebut.

Pelatih pemenang ajang Group 1 ini akan memulai harinya di balapan kedua saat Ausbred Yahoo bertarung di kelas Komatsu Country Boosted Benchmark 58 Handicap (1605 m), dengan joki magang Ella Drew yang mendapatkan dispensasi beban dua kilogram bertindak sebagai penunggang.

Gelaran balapan kuda kembali hadir di Coffs Harbour pada hari Minggu ini.

Ausbred Yahoo tengah berada dalam performa yang bagus, dengan raihan posisi ketiga di Kempsey tiga laga lalu diikuti oleh dua kali finis kedua berturut-turut di Coffs Harbour, yang terakhir saat dikalahkan oleh calon rivalnya hari Minggu nanti, Caledonian.

Mayfield-Smith akan bekerja sama dengan joki magang lainnya, Leanne Boyd yang mendapatkan dispensasi tiga kilogram, saat Never Island turun di kelas Insurance Advisernet Australia Pink Silks F&M Benchmark 58 Handicap (1305 m).

Mengantongi tiga kemenangan dari 15 laga yang telah dijalani, Never Island akan membawa beban seberat 59,5 kilogram setelah dikurangi dispensasi beban untuk Boyd. Never Island kalah tipis kurang dari satu panjang kuda saat finis kedua di belakang Montgomery di Grafton, dan melanjutkan performa tersebut dengan finis kelima pada laga terakhirnya di Coffs Harbour di belakang In The Fine Print, yang juga dengan selisih kekalahan kurang dari satu panjang kuda.

Raymond Spokes akan menunggangi Monte Cruise yang dilatih oleh Mayfield-Smith dalam ajang O'Brien Plumbing Relining Wayne Glenn Pink Silks Cup Benchmark 82 Handicap (1205 m).

Monte Cruise juga merupakan pemenang tiga kali dari baru sembilan laga yang diikutinya. Kuda ini belum pernah balapan lagi sejak Juli lalu saat finis di posisi terakhir dari delapan peserta di Eagle Farm, dan telah menjalani dua kali uji coba di lintasan ini sebagai persiapan untuk kembali bertanding, dengan finis kedua di belakang pemenang hari Sabtu di Wyong, Petticoat, sebelum akhirnya memenangi uji coba terbaru.

Mayfield-Smith akan menutup hari itu dengan kembali berkolaborasi bersama Boyd yang akan menunggangi Cardsharp di kelas Key Community Group C,G&E Benchmark 58 Handicap (1305 m).

Mayfield-Smith akan menutup hari itu dengan kembali berkolaborasi bersama Boyd yang akan menunggangi Cardsharp di kelas Key Community Group C,G&E Benchmark 58 Handicap (1305 m).

@la Isn't rule #1 of machining that if you haven't faced it off, it's not square or flat?

@azonenberg yes, of course, but I *did* mean to face it off. I just had my tool zero set wrong.
Because I assumed that it was roughtly flat.
I'm making an extra part today. I have the stock. And if I don't it will bug me to no end. Plus, during test fitting the bearing I broke the glue holding the part on my plate, so I would have to indicate it back in anyways, which I don't wanna dooooo, so.....

@la I know the feeling.
Had a similar problem when working on my house where literally every datum you might think of using was wrong.
I had a contractor frame a door frame plumb and square. Had to rip out a couple of studs after he left because the door needed to be like a degree off level in order to be flush with the floor and not floating in the air on one side.
Another (partial height) wall has each stud carefully cut to length because no two are the same size... The floor isn't flat so to make the countertop level you need the wall to be a parallelogram rather than a rectangle

Traction meets fashion: The best weatherproof trainers for rain-slicked pavements

The Cloudhorizon Waterproof feels purpose-built for the stop-start rhythm of winter commuting. Its lightweight waterproof upper keeps your feet dry without adding bulk, and the shoe's smooth rocker shape helps you roll forward easily, even when you're layered up and carrying heavy loads.

The pared-back design gives it a polished, modern look, ideal if you prefer a trainer that handles lousy weather subtly, without shouting its technical credentials.

Ironing the lightweight green corduroy for my first try at the Sachi's Studio Newsboy Cap pattern. I don't know how I feel about the recommendation to use interfacing but it probably does want something to stiffen and thicken it a bit.
#millinery

Sachi's newsboy cap pattern advises to cut the crown pieces diagonal to the weave ("on the bias") to allow more stretch around the circumference but that will make the corduroy rows run aslant, where I prefer them vertical.
We shall see. This is the test cookie to get a feel for the pattern. I like corduroy for texture but green wouldn't be my first choice, and this fabric is lightweight enough that I should add a layer, whether interfacing or what-have-you from the stash.

On a second look, my fabric isn't corduroy at all, it's just velvet, so I can cut at 45° to the fabric weave like Sachi suggests in the Newsboy Cap pattern and it won't look strange.
#millinery

Tonight in #MMRPG! My back finally shuts up enough that I can GM again as the heroes continue their search for the missing girl Cammie. Vega the Digital Dragon surprises a trio of mischievous scamps who snuck into her arcade in the middle of the night but one of them recognizes her as a town superhero and they end up having a heartwarming moment geeking out over video games. Unfortunately, the moment is interrupted by somebody or something landing on the roof of the arcade... 1/?

Vega goes to investigate and finds Dr. Vesper, in his monstrous bat form that the press has dubbed the "Gargoyle Man," along with a harpy-like creature that Vesper describes as his "little protegee." Vesper says that they have come to introduce themselves and invite Vega to join their society of man-creature misfits that is led by "The Madame," Dr. Diana Laughton of the Laughton Institute. 2/?

Vega buys some time to get the mischievous scamps out of the arcade and call the rest of the Mythics for backup, then plays along at being interested in joining this "new family." Vesper and Harpy (who does not speak once during the interaction) lead Vega to a ship in the harbor, where the Laughton Institute appears to be packing up their things... presumably because they know they're drawing attention from Agent Carter and A.R.G.E.N.T. among others. 3/?

High Noon review - Billy Crudup brings classic Hollywood western back with a bang

How do you turn a classic Hollywood western into West End musical fare? Add songs, many of Bruce Springsteen's in this case, along with a few rounds of line dancing and a sizzling star in Billy Crudup. Still, it's an odd experience initially as Thea Sharrock's production switches from one brief filmic scene to the next, and the endeavour seems as wooden as the clapboard saloon-bar slats that comprise the handsome set.

As a piece of theatre, it finds its flow. As a debate play, though, it gathers a locomotive energy as it travels towards the showdown between Frank Miller (James Doherty), who is returning to this "dirty little village in the middle of nowhere," and the marshal Will Kane (Crudup) who put him behind bars. That is mostly because of the uncanny and urgent relevance of this 1952 film about a community working out (or rather, squirming out of) its civic responsibilities around institutional wrongdoing.

Originally an allegory of McCarthyism (its screenwriter, Carl Foreman, was blacklisted), the story sets the cowardice of the many against the courage of the few - in this case, the lone, heroic Kane, who mobilises his defence against Miller and his henchmen after being let down by the townsfolk. The film was blasted by John Wayne as un-American for its critical portrait of the community; the production comes to life in its arguments on collective in/action and seems to speak directly about the dilemmas facing the cowboy country of Trump's America (the shooting in Minneapolis just the latest example). Eric Roth's script uses many lines from Foreman's screenplay but fleshes out the debates on the ethical stance of a community in the face of wrongdoing and misguided American myths around immigration.

Cowardice of the many, courage of the few ... cast of High Noon. Photograph: Johan Persson

There is also the joint talent of Crudup and the ever agile Denise Gough who play the central couple on their wedding day. She is Amy Fowler, a Quaker who abhors the actions of violent men; he is the marshal who has just given up his "tin star" to start over as a shopkeeper. That is, until news reaches town that Miller is arriving on the noon train.

Gary Cooper made the role entirely his own, his integrity comparable only to Gregory Peck's Atticus in To Kill a Mockingbird. So Crudup has his long shadow to evade. He manages to hold up the part on stage as an upstanding, earnest and increasingly desperate man. Gough makes her part grittier and more modern than that of her film counterpart, Grace Kelly. The pair are convincing as a couple although their narrow characterisation hems in the full scale of their abilities.

Several other characters seem too flimsy, from Billy Howle's deputy marshal, Harvey Pell, to Rosa Salazar's Mexican businesswoman, Helen, although the affinity between her and Amy is refreshing, and Roth gives more voice and texture to these women as a whole.

Several of Springsteen's songs bring their own American politics (from the frontier optimism of Land of Hope and Dreams to The Rising, written in response to 9/11). Some are sung a cappella, mostly by Gough, who is a strong singer, her voice emanating desolation, but she reprises I'm on Fire one too many times.

It seems like a reluctant musical at times, the songs short and thin but the percussive music and sound design are always arresting, as is the lighting, designed by Neil Austin, which brings emotional clarity and intrigue. A clock is central to Tim Hatley's set design, counting down to the train's thrilling arrival and the subsequent showdown, which manages to contain tension and drama, despite the difficulty of staging a cross-town shootout.

For all its early stiffness, it builds in momentum and there are moving moments. Ultimately, the political message speaks loudest, harnessing the McCarthyist fear of then and the Trumpian terror of today.

Ulasan High Noon - Billy Crudup menghidupkan kembali western klasik Hollywood dengan gebrakan

Bagaimana mengubah western klasik Hollywood menjadi sajian musikal West End? Tambahkan lagu-lagu - dalam hal ini banyak karya Bruce Springsteen - disertai beberapa putaran line dancing dan pesona membara dari Billy Crudup. Meski begitu, pada awalnya ini terasa sebagai pengalaman yang ganjil ketika produksi garapan Thea Sharrock berpindah dari satu adegan pendek yang sinematik ke adegan berikutnya, dan keseluruhan upayanya tampak sekaku papan-papan dinding bar saloon yang membentuk set yang menawan itu.

Sebagai karya teater, pementasan ini pada akhirnya menemukan ritmenya. Namun sebagai drama gagasan, ia mengumpulkan energi seperti lokomotif saat melaju menuju konfrontasi antara Frank Miller (James Doherty), yang kembali ke "desa kecil kumuh di tengah antah-berantah" ini, dan marshal Will Kane (Crudup) yang dahulu menjebloskannya ke penjara. Itu terutama karena relevansi film tahun 1952 ini yang terasa luar biasa sekaligus mendesak: tentang sebuah komunitas yang berusaha menjalankan - atau lebih tepatnya, mengelak dari - tanggung jawab sipilnya di tengah kesalahan institusional.

Pada mulanya merupakan alegori McCarthyisme (penulis skenarionya, Carl Foreman, masuk daftar hitam), kisah ini mempertentangkan kepengecutan orang banyak dengan keberanian segelintir orang - dalam hal ini Kane, sosok heroik yang berdiri sendiri, yang mengerahkan pertahanannya melawan Miller dan kaki tangannya setelah dikecewakan warga kota. Film ini pernah dihujat John Wayne sebagai tidak mencerminkan Amerika karena penggambaran kritisnya terhadap komunitas tersebut; produksi panggung ini justru hidup lewat perdebatan tentang tindakan dan ketidakbertindakan kolektif, dan terasa berbicara langsung mengenai dilema yang dihadapi negeri koboi dalam Amerika era Trump (penembakan di Minneapolis hanyalah contoh terbarunya). Naskah Eric Roth menggunakan banyak dialog dari skenario Foreman, tetapi memperkaya perdebatan tentang sikap etis sebuah komunitas dalam menghadapi kesalahan serta mitos-mitos Amerika yang keliru tentang imigrasi.

Kepengecutan orang banyak, keberanian segelintir orang ... para pemeran High Noon. Foto: Johan Persson

Ada pula kekuatan gabungan Crudup dan Denise Gough yang selalu lincah, yang memerankan pasangan utama pada hari pernikahan mereka. Ia adalah Amy Fowler, seorang Quaker yang membenci tindakan para lelaki penuh kekerasan; sementara ia adalah marshal yang baru saja menanggalkan "bintang timah"-nya untuk memulai hidup baru sebagai pemilik toko. Demikian adanya, sampai kabar sampai ke kota bahwa Miller datang dengan kereta tengah hari.

Gary Cooper menjadikan peran itu sepenuhnya miliknya, dengan integritas yang hanya sebanding dengan Atticus versi Gregory Peck dalam To Kill a Mockingbird. Karena itu, Crudup harus menghindari bayang-bayang panjang tersebut. Ia berhasil menopang peran ini di panggung sebagai sosok yang terhormat, tulus, dan kian terdesak. Gough membuat perannya lebih keras dan lebih modern daripada lawan mainnya di versi film, Grace Kelly. Keduanya meyakinkan sebagai pasangan, meskipun karakterisasi yang sempit membatasi keseluruhan keluasan kemampuan mereka.

Beberapa karakter lain terasa terlalu tipis, mulai dari deputi marshal Harvey Pell yang diperankan Billy Howle hingga pebisnis Meksiko Helen yang dimainkan Rosa Salazar, meskipun kedekatan antara Helen dan Amy terasa menyegarkan, dan Roth secara keseluruhan memberi lebih banyak suara serta tekstur kepada tokoh-tokoh perempuan ini.

Sejumlah lagu Springsteen membawa politik Amerikanya sendiri (dari optimisme perbatasan dalam Land of Hope and Dreams hingga The Rising, yang ditulis sebagai respons terhadap 9/11). Sebagiannya dinyanyikan secara a cappella, terutama oleh Gough, yang merupakan penyanyi tangguh dengan suara yang memancarkan kepedihan, tetapi ia mengulang I'm on Fire sedikit terlalu sering.

Pada saat-saat tertentu, ini terasa seperti musikal yang setengah hati; lagu-lagunya pendek dan tipis, tetapi musik perkusi dan tata suaranya selalu memikat, demikian pula tata cahaya rancangan Neil Austin, yang menghadirkan kejernihan emosi dan daya tarik. Sebuah jam menjadi pusat rancangan set Tim Hatley, menghitung mundur menuju kedatangan kereta yang mendebarkan dan konfrontasi sesudahnya, yang berhasil menghadirkan ketegangan dan drama meskipun menampilkan baku tembak lintas kota di atas panggung bukan hal mudah.

Terlepas dari kekakuannya di awal, pementasan ini terus membangun momentum dan menghadirkan sejumlah momen yang menyentuh. Pada akhirnya, pesan politiknyalah yang berbicara paling lantang, memanfaatkan ketakutan era McCarthy dahulu dan teror ala Trump masa kini.

source_doc:
Ashley Barnes at the double as Burnley claim welcome win over Millwall

Ashley Barnes bagged a brace as Burnley put their Premier League worries on hold to cruise into the fourth round of the FA Cup with a 5-1 win over Millwall.

The 36-year-old scored his first goal of the season early on and added his second midway through the second half as the blundering Lions gifted a confident home side the most emphatic of wins.

Boss Scott Parker made eight changes to the side that started in Wednesday's 2-2 draw with Manchester United and they did not disappoint, as further goals from Loum Tchaouna and Jaidon Anthony put them out of sight by half-time.

Substitute Jaydon Banel added Burnley's fifth on the stroke of 90 minutes before the shell-shocked Lions, who had completely capitulated, netted an added-time consolation through Josh Coburn.

Burnley dominated the opening exchanges and grabbed the lead in the 11th minute when Jacob Bruun Larsen squared for Barnes to sweep home past visiting goalkeeper Steven Benda.

The Lions mustered little in response, with Aidomo Emakhu booting their best chance straight at Burnley keeper Max Weiss after being released down the left by Joe Bryan.

But the visitors slowly grew into the game and should have levelled when Jake Cooper got his head on Alfie Doughty's cross from deep on the left but was denied by a brilliant over-arm save from Weiss.

The keeper saved again from Cooper on the half-hour as Millwall threatened a leveller but the visitors were undone by two defensive errors that put the game beyond their grasp.

Tchaouna was allowed to thread his left-foot shot from the edge of the box past a static Benda on 35 minutes and shortly before the break the Millwall keeper's poor clearance ultimately gifted Anthony the chance to slide home his side's third.

Millwall looked livelier at the start of the second half and Thierno Ballo should have done better when he found space to get a shot off in the left side of the box, but the home side were clearly in cruise control.

Tchaouna came close to his second when he rifled a shot against the outside of Benda's right-hand post and the increasingly inevitable fourth arrived on 65 minutes when Kamarl Grant made a hash of clearing Anthony's right-wing cross and a delighted Barnes mopped up.

Hunting for a hat-trick, Barnes flashed a header straight at Benda as the linesman's flag was raised, but it was Banel who completed the rout from close range before Coburn's confident finish in stoppage time.

Ashley Barnes mencetak dua gol saat Burnley sejenak melupakan kecemasan mereka di Liga Primer untuk melaju mulus ke putaran keempat Piala FA dengan kemenangan telak 5-1 atas Millwall.

Pemain berusia 36 tahun tersebut mencetak gol pertamanya musim ini di awal laga dan menggandakannya di pertengahan babak kedua, saat blunder demi blunder dari skuad The Lions memberi tim tuan rumah yang tampil percaya diri kemenangan yang sangat meyakinkan.

Manajer Scott Parker melakukan delapan perubahan dari susunan pemain yang diturunkan saat bermain imbang 2-2 kontra Manchester United pada hari Rabu, dan keputusan itu tidak mengecewakan setelah gol tambahan dari Loum Tchaouna dan Jaidon Anthony membuat mereka unggul jauh sebelum turun minum.

Pemain pengganti Jaydon Banel mencetak gol kelima Burnley tepat pada menit ke-90 sebelum The Lions yang tampak terguncang dan telah menyerah sepenuhnya, mencetak gol hiburan di masa tambahan waktu melalui Josh Coburn.

Burnley mendominasi jalannya menit-menit awal pertandingan dan membuka keunggulan pada menit ke-11 saat umpan tarik Jacob Bruun Larsen diselesaikan dengan sempurna oleh Barnes untuk menaklukkan kiper tim tamu, Steven Benda.

The Lions tidak banyak memberikan respons, dengan peluang terbaik dari Aidomo Emakhu yang melepaskan tembakan tepat ke arah kiper Burnley, Max Weiss, setelah lolos di sisi kiri berkat umpan Joe Bryan.

Namun, tim tamu perlahan mulai berkembang dan seharusnya bisa menyamakan kedudukan ketika sundulan Jake Cooper menyambut umpan silang Alfie Doughty dari sisi kiri berhasil digagalkan oleh penyelamatan gemilang Weiss.

Sang kiper kembali mementahkan peluang Cooper pada menit ke-30 saat Millwall mengancam untuk menyamakan skor, tetapi tim tamu harus membayar mahal akibat dua kesalahan lini pertahanan yang membuat pertandingan berada di luar jangkauan mereka.

Tchaouna dibiarkan melepaskan tembakan kaki kiri dari luar kotak penalti melewati Benda yang terpaku pada menit ke-35, dan sesaat sebelum jeda, sapuan buruk dari kiper Millwall tersebut akhirnya memberikan kesempatan bagi Anthony untuk menyontek bola masuk guna mencetak gol ketiga timnya.

Millwall tampil lebih hidup di awal babak kedua dan Thierno Ballo seharusnya bisa berbuat lebih baik ketika ia mendapatkan ruang untuk melepaskan tembakan di sisi kiri kotak penalti, tetapi tim tuan rumah jelas telah memegang kendali penuh permainan.

Tchaouna nyaris mencetak gol keduanya saat tembakan kerasnya membentur bagian luar tiang kanan gawang Benda, dan gol keempat yang tampaknya tak terhindarkan akhirnya tercipta pada menit ke-65 ketika Kamarl Grant melakukan kesalahan saat menghalau umpan silang Anthony dari sisi kanan, yang langsung disambar dengan mudah oleh Barnes.

Demi memburu trigol, Barnes melepaskan sundulan yang mengarah tepat ke Benda saat bendera hakim garis diangkat, tetapi justru Banel yang menyempurnakan pesta gol dari jarak dekat sebelum penyelesaian tenang Coburn di masa tambahan waktu.

Demi memburu trigol, Barnes melepaskan sundulan yang mengarah tepat ke Benda saat bendera hakim garis diangkat, tetapi justru Banel yang menyempurnakan pesta gol dari jarak dekat sebelum penyelesaian tenang Coburn di masa tambahan waktu.

Not that the cops care, they are probably giddy with excitement now (a gross thing to imagine) that they have a pretense to raid and criminalize the leftist scene.

@enby_of_the_apocalypse
Yeah, I mean it seems like there's still about half a dozen anticivs raised on meme accounts who are shocked the scene didn't stand with them, but are extremely shocked that old timer anticivs who felt disrespected by said crew and haven't backed them.

@enby_of_the_apocalypse
I do worry that we'll see a self-justification spiral where a handful of anticivs get so mad at the movement for not supporting their super based attack on the civilized that they end up in ITS level shit within a year or two of isolation and seething.

source_doc:
Good Morning Worlds!
We are going to the tip this morning. It will clear some of the stuff we sorted yesterday from the drive. I don't think we can clear it all unless we took the trailer, but the trailer is full of steel for weighing in.
Later I might carry on packing tote crates.
#GoodMorningWorlds

Tip trip done, and another car load cleared out.
I have taken the new trailer axle, and trailer drive motor system, out of the scrap metal trailer load. That means we can get more scrap metal in there and also not accidentally weigh in the parts I want to keep.
I think, next, I will start moving the scrap steel from the back garden into the trailer so that it is ready to go.
Scrap steel prices are not very high at the moment but better than nothing, if I take enough of it in one go.
Still have to sort the non-ferrous scrap.

That thing when you are taking the rotten tyres off small, wide lawn tractor wheels....
Huge effort to unmount one side of the tyre, but it was really badly rusted tight on the other side of the rim.
In the time it took me to break the bead free, I'd forgotten I had already done the other side, and ended up with the rim free but completely inside the tyre!
I had to remount the tyre that side, and then work around it to get the rim out.
I had to cut up the inner tube to get that out too!
I wonder how many more tyres I need to unmount? Four done so far.

Pagi Dunia!
Pagi ini kami mau ke tempat pembuangan sampah. Ini bakal ngurangin barang-barang di jalan masuk yang kemarin udah kami pilah. Kayaknya gak bakal bersih semua sih kalau gak bawa trailer, tapi trailernya lagi penuh besi tua buat ditimbang.
Nanti mungkin aku bakal lanjut ngepak kotak kontainer.
#GoodMorningWorlds

Urusan buang sampah beres, dan satu muatan mobil lagi udah bersih.
Aku udah ngeluarin poros trailer baru, sama sistem motor penggerak trailer, dari muatan besi tua di trailer. Berarti kita bisa masukin lebih banyak besi tua ke situ dan gak bakal sengaja nimbang suku cadang yang masih mau aku simpan.
Kayaknya, abis ini, aku bakal mulai mindahin besi tua dari kebun belakang ke trailer biar siap dibawa.
Harga besi tua lagi gak terlalu bagus saat ini, tapi lumayanlah daripada gak ada sama sekali, kalau aku bawa banyak sekaligus.
Masih harus milah rongsokan non-besi juga.

Momen pas lagi ngelepas ban yang udah hancur dari roda traktor rumput yang kecil dan lebar....
Butuh usaha keras banget buat ngelepas satu sisi ban, tapi sisi satunya lagi bener-bener karatan parah dan nempel kencang di pelek.
Saking lamanya aku nyoba ngelepas pinggiran bannya, aku sampai lupa kalau sisi satunya udah lepas, dan akhirnya peleknya lepas tapi malah masuk sepenuhnya ke dalem ban!
Aku harus masang bannya lagi di sisi itu, terus ngakalin biar peleknya bisa keluar.
Aku juga harus motong ban dalemnya biar bisa keluar!
Kira-kira berapa ban lagi ya yang harus aku lepas? Sejauh ini udah beres empat.

source_doc:
I wish alcohol wasn't such a normal gift in society 😅 My employer sent me a bottle of eggnog but the only alcohol we like is in alcohol markers

I guess "not liking it" is kinda poor wording, I just think it's weird how casual we are with this stuff and we somehow just assume that all adults love this shit when there's people who shouldn't be touching it ever, and frankly I think the world would be better off if I poured it into the toilet than even gifting it to someone

@doombloomart
I have had US Big Corp required sensitivity training that reminds people not everyone wants alcohol and it's inappropriate to ask why. Seems like that should be more common

@elithebearded Yeah, that's mostly what I wish for too. I get that with sending random shit to a whole corporation will never be inoffensive to everyone, but 1. don't send random shit to a whole corporation maybe and 2. alcohol just rubs me wrong in the way that many who shouldn't touch it may touch it when it randomly shows up at the doorstep. 😅

Celtic hammer Dundee United on O'Neill's return

Normal service resumed at Celtic Park as champions Celtic secured a dominant 4-0 win over Dundee United and their first clean sheet since Martin O'Neill's previous game in charge.

Two first-half goals in five minutes from Yang Hyun-jun and Arne Engels sent Celtic on their way as O'Neill returned to the dugout in style following Wilfried Nancy's brief but disastrous reign.

Substitute Benjamin Nygren grabbed his 11th goal of the season and Daizen Maeda netted on the rebound to equal Celtic's two biggest wins of the league season so far. Both of them were in O'Neill's caretaker spell in charge, which resulted in seven wins from eight games.

Celtic sent for the 73-year-old on Monday after terminating Nancy's contract in the wake of six defeats - and 18 goals against - in eight matches.

The chaos, confusion and defensive fragility that marked Nancy's reign disappeared as the Hoops moved three points off the top of the table.

Nobody in the stadium would have been surprised to see O'Neill restore Celtic's long-standing 4-3-3 formation and the team picked up where they left off under O'Neill, as if they had awoken from a nightmare and got on with life as normal.

Centre-back Liam Scales was back to the consistent form he displayed before suffering in and out of a back three under the Frenchman.

Callum McGregor dictated play again and Celtic's wide players, Yang and Sebastian Tounekti, were given attacking licence after being handed wing-back roles by the former Columbus Crew head coach.

Celtic enjoyed 78 per cent possession, had 22 shots at goal and let United have just three. Their opponents averaged 12 shots during Nancy's tenure and United managed 17 themselves during their 2-1 win over the Hoops at Tannadice less than four weeks ago.

Celtic penned United in from the start, with Kieran Tierney instrumental in creating a series of first-half chances.

The left-back had a shot deflected wide, Yang and Scales threatened from headers and Maeda flicked a low cross of the bar, before the pressure paid off in the 27th minute.

Such was Celtic's dominance that Scales found himself in possession on the edge of the box and rolled a pass to Yang, who drilled home from 20 yards.

Maeda soon mis-kicked a volley before Engels produced a first-time finish from Tierney's pass.

It was not all plain sailing for Celtic in the first half. Mexican right-back Julian Araujo marked his first start with a yellow card for a dangerous challenge on Will Ferry, who was still hobbling when he took the resulting free-kick.

United also had chances and Dario Naamo looked unsure whether to head or volley Craig Sibbald's deep cross and did neither and Owen Stirton twice came close.

The striker was firstly foiled by a goal-saving block from Scales after being gifted possession by Auston Trusty and later shot just wide from 18 yards after the Celtic central defence backed off.

United brought on winger Amar Fatah for holding midfielder Pan Camara at half-time but Celtic were even more dominant in the second half.

Reo Hatate and Maeda missed good chances before Nygren shot high into the net from six yards in the 63rd minute.

Maeda had an easy finish six minutes later after Tounekti's shot was saved.

Celtic Cukur Dundee United dalam Laga Kembalinya O'Neill

Kondisi normal kembali tercipta di Celtic Park setelah sang juara bertahan, Celtic, mengamankan kemenangan telak 4-0 atas Dundee United sekaligus mencatatkan nirbobol pertama mereka sejak laga terakhir Martin O'Neill pada periode kepelatihan sebelumnya.

Dua gol babak pertama dalam kurun waktu lima menit dari Yang Hyun-jun dan Arne Engels memuluskan langkah Celtic, menandai kembalinya O'Neill ke bangku cadangan dengan gemilang setelah masa kepelatihan singkat yang berujung bencana di bawah Wilfried Nancy.

Pemain pengganti Benjamin Nygren mencetak gol ke-11 nya musim ini dan Daizen Maeda menyambar bola muntah untuk menyamai dua kemenangan terbesar Celtic di liga sejauh musim ini. Kedua kemenangan tersebut diraih saat O'Neill menjabat sebagai pelatih sementara, yang menghasilkan tujuh kemenangan dari delapan pertandingan.

Celtic memanggil kembali pelatih berusia 73 tahun itu pada hari Senin setelah memutus kontrak Nancy menyusul enam kekalahan—dan kebobolan 18 gol—dalam delapan pertandingan.

Kekacauan, kebingungan, dan kerapuhan lini pertahanan yang mewarnai era Nancy seketika sirna saat The Hoops kini memangkas jarak menjadi tiga poin dari puncak klasemen.

Tidak ada seorang pun di stadion yang terkejut melihat O'Neill menerapkan kembali formasi andalan 4-3-3, dan tim langsung melanjutkan performa apik mereka di bawah O'Neill, seolah-olah mereka baru saja terbangun dari mimpi buruk dan kembali menjalani kehidupan seperti biasa.

Bek tengah Liam Scales kembali menemukan bentuk permainan konsistennya setelah sempat kesulitan akibat keluar-masuk skema tiga bek di bawah asuhan pelatih asal Prancis tersebut.

Callum McGregor kembali mengatur ritme permainan, sementara para pemain sayap Celtic, Yang dan Sebastian Tounekti, diberikan kebebasan menyerang setelah sebelumnya diplot sebagai bek sayap oleh mantan pelatih kepala Columbus Crew tersebut.

Celtic mendominasi 78 persen penguasaan bola, melepaskan 22 tembakan dan hanya membiarkan United melakukan tiga tembakan. Lawan-lawan mereka rata-rata melepaskan 12 tembakan selama masa jabatan Nancy, sementara United sendiri mampu melepaskan 17 tembakan saat menang 2-1 atas The Hoops di Tannadice kurang dari empat minggu lalu.

Celtic mengurung pertahanan United sejak awal laga, dengan Kieran Tierney berperan penting dalam menciptakan serangkaian peluang di babak pertama.

Tembakan bek kiri tersebut sempat berbelok arah setelah membentur lawan dan melebar, sementara Yang dan Scales menebar ancaman lewat sundulan, dan sontekan Maeda menyambut umpan silang rendah membentur mistar gawang, sebelum tekanan bertubi-tubi itu akhirnya membuahkan hasil pada menit ke-27.

Saking dominannya Celtic, Scales bahkan menguasai bola di tepi kotak penalti lawan dan menyodorkan umpan kepada Yang, yang langsung melepaskan tembakan keras dari jarak 20 yard.

Maeda sempat gagal melakukan tendangan voli dengan sempurna sebelum Engels mencetak gol melalui penyelesaian akhir sekali sentuh memanfaatkan umpan Tierney.

Meski begitu, babak pertama tidak sepenuhnya berjalan mulus bagi Celtic. Bek kanan asal Meksiko, Julian Araujo, menandai laga perdananya sebagai starter dengan kartu kuning akibat pelanggaran keras terhadap Will Ferry, yang masih tampak pincang saat mengambil tendangan bebas setelahnya.

United juga sempat memiliki peluang; Dario Naamo tampak ragu-ragu antara menyundul atau melakukan tendangan voli menyambut umpan silang lambung Craig Sibbald sehingga gagal memanfaatkan peluang, sementara Owen Stirton dua kali nyaris mencetak gol.

Pemain depan tersebut pertama-tama digagalkan oleh blok penyelamatan krusial dari Scales setelah mendapat bola gratis akibat kesalahan Auston Trusty, dan kemudian melepaskan tembakan yang melebar tipis dari jarak 18 yard setelah lini pertahanan tengah Celtic terlambat menutup ruang.

United memasukkan pemain sayap Amar Fatah menggantikan gelandang bertahan Pan Camara di babak pertama, namun Celtic justru tampil semakin dominan di babak kedua.

Reo Hatate dan Maeda menyia-nyiakan peluang bagus sebelum Nygren melepaskan tembakan keras ke langit-langit gawang dari jarak enam yard pada menit ke-63.

Maeda akhirnya mencetak gol dengan penyelesaian mudah enam menit kemudian setelah tembakan Tounekti berhasil ditepis.

@JugglingWithEggs at least in my friend circle mobile phones not uncommon from early 90s, but they cost a *lot* to call from a landline (so if you were living at home your parents would discourage it), and until 1995-1999 were insecure, anyone with a radio scanner could (and often did) listen to them.
Whilst radio scanners were out of the price range of youths, many older folk had them, and until late 90s were often the kind of radio enthusiast who was a Tory bootlicker and supported the Police and other Establishment organisations, so you if discussing anything subversive on a mobile phone you risked being grassed up..
Ironically the tide turned by late 90s when scanners became affordable, and the Police were still on analogue radios 😁

@JugglingWithEggs by late 1990s everyone had a mobile phone and calls were cheaper (often with a good amount of free minutes) but SMS messages were unreliable and initially didn't even work across networks - people actually talked to each other on them!
One difference was access to physical spaces wasn't as heavily controlled as today - even though there was still CCTV and locals would call old bill on youths "hanging around", there was neither sufficient boots on the ground nor interconnected CCTV (a real security guard had to watch the footage locally, and property owners generally didn't want to pay for these folk at evenings and weekends.
There were also fewer cops on duty in outer suburbs during nights/weekends - they were all deployed into the town centres)

@vfrmedia
I remember texts sometimes taking hours to come through in the early noughties - so not always great for making on the fly arrangements.
Living in market town definitely meant less cctv and coppers back in 90’s. Remember difference when heading out into Bournemouth or Norwich of an evening. But young people having fun wasn’t frowned upon like it is now. My earlier post about facial recognition was about area where there has been uptick in teens just hanging out.

Meskipun pemindai radio itu di luar jangkauan kantong anak muda, banyak orang tua yang punya, dan sampai akhir tahun 90-an mereka itu sering kali tipe penggemar radio yang jadi penjilat Tory dan ngedukung polisi serta organisasi kemapanan lainnya, jadi kalau kamu ngebahas hal-hal yang berbau subversif di hp, kamu berisiko diadukan...
Ironisnya keadaan berbalik di akhir tahun 90-an waktu pemindai radio mulai murah, dan polisi masih pakai radio analog 😁

@JugglingWithEggs pas akhir 1990-an semua orang udah punya hp dan biaya telepon lebih murah (sering kali dapet banyak bonus menit gratis) tapi SMS sering eror dan awalnya malah gak bisa dikirim lintas operator - orang-orang beneran teleponan buat ngobrol!
Salah satu bedanya dulu itu akses ke ruang publik gak dijaga ketat kayak sekarang - meskipun udah ada CCTV dan warga sekitar bakal ngelaporin polisi kalau ada anak muda yang "nongkrong-nongkrong", personel di lapangan gak cukup dan CCTV-nya juga belum saling terhubung (satpam beneran harus mantau rekaman langsung di lokasi, dan pemilik properti biasanya gak mau bayar orang-orang ini pas malam hari dan akhir pekan).
Polisi yang bertugas di pinggiran kota juga lebih sedikit pas malam/akhir pekan - mereka semua dikerahkan ke pusat kota)

@vfrmedia
Aku inget dulu pas awal tahun 2000-an SMS kadang butuh waktu berjam-jam buat masuk - jadi gak selalu bisa diandalin buat bikin janji mendadak.
Tinggal di kota kecil emang beneran minim CCTV dan polisi pas tahun 90-an dulu. Inget banget bedanya pas lagi main ke Bournemouth atau Norwich pas malam hari. Tapi anak muda yang lagi seneng-seneng gak terlalu dipandang sinis kayak sekarang. Postingan pertamaku tentang pengenalan wajah itu tentang daerah yang lagi banyak banget remaja nongkrong.

project move out, spring break relay
day 1:
Cleared main bedroom closet
& contents of boxes on one wall.
I'm surveying all my belongings. Pulling out a small percentage to save. Sentimental items. Practical pieces for putting together a new life. At this stage I know I'm selecting more than I need, probably more than I can carry; but the amount that I'm leaving behind is far greater. Deciding what to keep & where comes after the survey. All the rest will be turned over to "scavengers."
#moverR

Day 2, midday break, Monday.
Today is harder than yesterday. I'm uncovering far more "sentimental" stuff. The challenge: these saved memories are a physical drag that impair rather than contribute anything practically to my future AND I feel integrated looking at them. There's a strong general condemnation, I feel, of holding onto sentimental items. Yet I know that they are powerful. But hey, I'm an artist. Even wistful, sad memories are valuable to me. I'm proceeding as before, retaining less+

+than I'm tossing, while knowing that I am keeping "too much." The next phase will be the actual moving & storing phase when more might be cut. This phase is the pre-screen before turning the cleared items over to others who will take everything away.
File under: how to move out of a home of 12 years & a home town of 45 years, with family roots here (& artifacts) from 150 years. I'm finally leaving, in search of a culture that suits my values.
#moverR

In a surprise Inspector Clouseau twist, I now have an extra thing to investigate for Spooky Kitties Sciences!
I was doing a quick scroll through the evenings secondary camera video, when I spotted a curious The Inspector standing on the trunk of the tree near the feeding station. Kept jumping around, finding him near where the magpies had been, so I initially suspect(edit) he was simply chasing them as they sometimes let him do, until I randomly chance stop...
#SpookyKittiesSciences

There Inspector Clouseau was, rolling around like crazing about 2 meters NE of the tree, mostly hidden by the unfortunate placement of the awnings east post. Still, there he was for 5 minutes, at which point he ran back up the tree, walked across the lawn to the hill, flattened himself at the bottom, and then ran off camera, presumably in the middle of The Zoomies.
2/
#SpookyKittiesSciences

Now, as some of my Spooky Kitties Sciences readers may know, the motivations behind that tests are not just to entertain the kitties. While the most important aspect is the genuine curiosity I had seeing the kitties rolling around in the snow, I really wanted to find something that The Inspector liked. I came out of the initial testing with only a single moment to hint that he liked something. What that was is still a mystery.
3/
#SpookyKittiesSciences

Gak disangka-sangka, kayak plot twist Inspektur Clouseau, sekarang aku punya satu hal tambahan buat diselidiki untuk Spooky Kitties Sciences!
Pas lagi nge-scroll cepat rekaman kamera sekunder malam ini, aku ngelihat si Inspektur yang penasaran lagi berdiri di batang pohon deket tempat makan. Dia loncat-loncat terus, dan pas nemuin dia di deket tempat para burung murai tadinya berada, awalnya aku curiga (edit) dia cuma lagi ngejar mereka kayak yang biasa mereka biarin, sampai akhirnya aku gak sengaja berhenti...
#SpookyKittiesSciences

Si Inspektur Clouseau ada di sana, guling-guling kayak orang gila sekitar 2 meter di sebelah timur laut pohon, sebagian besar ketutupan gara-gara posisi tiang timur kanopi yang kurang pas. Tapi tetep aja, dia di sana selama 5 menit, terus dia lari balik ke atas pohon, jalan ngelewati halaman rumput ke arah bukit, tiarap di bagian bawah, lalu lari keluar dari jangkauan kamera, kayaknya lagi dapet Zoomies.
2/
#SpookyKittiesSciences

Nah, kayak yang mungkin udah diketahui sama sebagian pembaca Spooky Kitties Sciences, motivasi di balik tes itu bukan cuma buat ngehibur para kucing. Meskipun aspek paling pentingnya adalah rasa penasaran beneranku pas ngelihat kucing-kucing itu guling-guling di salju, aku pengen banget nemuin sesuatu yang disukai si Inspektur. Arthur Okonkwo's penalty shootout heroics causes FA Cup shock as Wrexham beat Nottingham Forest

Wrexham won an FA Cup third-round thriller in front of Hollywood owner Ryan Reynolds as Nottingham Forest were dumped out of the competition on penalties after a 3-3 draw.

Arthur Okonkwo was the Wrexham hero with stops from Igor Jesus and Omari Hutchinson giving them a 4-3 victory on spot-kicks after Josh Windass, Callum Doyle, George Thomason and Jay Rodriguez had converted from the spot.

First-half goals from Liberato Cacace and Oliver Rathbone gave Wrexham early control and had Reynolds trading high fives and hugs from his vantage point in the main stand.

Jesus cut the deficit before Dominic Hyam's diving header restored Wrexham's two-goal advantage with 16 minutes remaining.

Forest looked dead and buried but substitute Callum Hudson-Odoi produced two outstanding finishes, the equaliser coming in the 89th minute.

Wrexham have won three successive promotions to go from non-league to the Championship, but this was the first time since being taken over by Reynolds and fellow actor Rob Mac nearly five years ago they had met Premier League opposition.

Forest made eight changes after beating West Ham on Tuesday, with goalkeeper Matz Sels, Jesus and Hutchinson remaining and Wales international Neco Williams on a stacked bench at his local club.

Callum Hudson-Odoi came off the bench and scored twice to force the match to penalties (REUTERS)

Kieffer Moore was not risked after injury as Wrexham sought to extend a four-game winning streak that had taken them a point from the Championship play-off places.

Forest started on the front front with Jesus shooting over and Douglas Luiz found the net after 17 minutes.

Referee Paul Tierney initially awarded the goal, but then ruled it out after deciding Luiz had controlled the ball with his arm before volleying home.

Wrexham had been tidy in possession without a cutting edge but that was to change in the final 10 minutes of the first half.

Ollie Rathbone doubled Wrexham's lead after Liberato Cacace's opener (REUTERS)

Sam Smith dragged wide before Cacace took advantage after 37 minutes to drive home his maiden Wrexham goal from 20 yards aided by the faintest of deflections off Morato's heel.

Wrexham smiles were even wider three minutes later as Rathbone broke through Morato's challenge to fire in his third goal in four games.

It should have been three - and possibly contest over - when Smith scampered through the Forest half unchecked but failed to beat Sels" outstretched leg.

Forest boss Sean Dyche made a triple substitution at half-time with Williams, Morgan Gibbs-White and Nicolas Dominguez sent on to salvage the situation.

Okonkwo saved the decisive penalty to deny Omari Hutchinson in the shootout (Martin Rickett/PA Wire)

The visitors were instantly more fluid as Okonkwo tipped over Luiz's free-kick and kept out Nicolo Savona's strike.

Sels saved well from Broadhead but Forest were in the ascendancy and struck when Savona set up the leaping Jesus for a header that hit the post and just about crossed the line.

The drama rose as Hyam headed in a superb George Dobson free-kick and Hudson-Odoi swept home 60 seconds later to set up a grandstand finish.

Hudson-Odoi took the tie into extra time in fantastic fashion, taking a touch on his chest and lofting a perfect volley over Okonkwo, but Wrexham were not to be denied their first top-flight FA Cup scalp for 26 years.

Sean Dyche made eight changes to the Forest side and called on his first choice players but couldn't get over the line (Martin Rickett/PA Wire)

Elsewhere in the FA Cup, Oxford United advanced to the fourth round with a 4-3 penalty shootout win over MK Dons and Port Vale defeated Fleetwood 1-0.

Wigan Athletic also progressed after a superb display at Deepdale saw the League One side beat Championship play-off chasers Preston North End 1-0 as well.

hypothesis:
Aksi heroik Arthur Okonkwo dalam adu penalti ciptakan kejutan di Piala FA saat Wrexham singkirkan Nottingham Forest

Wrexham memenangkan laga babak ketiga Piala FA yang mendebarkan di hadapan sang pemilik asal Hollywood, Ryan Reynolds, setelah menyingkirkan Nottingham Forest lewat adu penalti menyusul hasil imbang 3-3.

Arthur Okonkwo menjadi pahlawan Wrexham dengan mementahkan tendangan Igor Jesus dan Omari Hutchinson untuk memastikan kemenangan 4-3 dalam adu penalti, setelah Josh Windass, Callum Doyle, George Thomason, dan Jay Rodriguez sukses mengeksekusi penalti mereka.

Gol di babak pertama dari Liberato Cacace and Oliver Rathbone memberi Wrexham keunggulan awal dan membuat Reynolds merayakannya dengan saling tos dan berpelukan dari tribun utama.

Jesus memperkecil ketertinggalan sebelum sundulan sambil menjatuhkan diri dari Dominic Hyam memulihkan keunggulan dua gol Wrexham saat laga menyisakan 16 menit.

Forest tampak sudah habis, namun pemain pengganti Callum Hudson-Odoi menghasilkan dua penyelesaian gemilang, dengan gol penyeimbang tercipta pada menit ke-89.

Wrexham telah memenangkan tiga promosi berturut-turut untuk naik dari divisi non-liga ke Championship, tetapi ini adalah pertama kalinya sejak diambil alih oleh Reynolds dan sesama aktor Rob McElhenney hampir lima tahun lalu mereka menghadapi tim dari Premier League.

Forest melakukan delapan perubahan setelah mengalahkan West Ham pada hari Selasa, dengan kiper Matz Sels, Jesus, dan Hutchinson tetap dipertahankan, sementara pemain internasional Wales Neco Williams berada di bangku cadangan klub masa kecilnya.

Callum Hudson-Odoi masuk dari bangku cadangan dan mencetak dua gol untuk memaksakan pertandingan berlanjut ke babak adu penalti (REUTERS)

Kieffer Moore tidak mengambil risiko dimainkan setelah cedera saat Wrexham berusaha memperpanjang empat kemenangan beruntun yang membawa mereka terpaut satu poin dari zona play-off Championship.

Forest memulai laga dengan menekan lewat tembakan Jesus yang melambung di atas gawang, dan Douglas Luiz berhasil membobol gawang setelah 17 menit pertandingan berjalan.

Wasit Paul Tierney awalnya mengesahkan gol tersebut, namun kemudian menganulirnya setelah memutuskan bahwa Luiz telah mengontrol bola dengan tangannya sebelum melepaskan tembakan voli.

Wrexham tampil rapi dalam penguasaan bola namun kurang tajam dalam menyerang, tetapi hal itu berubah dalam 10 menit terakhir babak pertama.

Ollie Rathbone menggandakan keunggulan Wrexham setelah gol pembuka dari Liberato Cacace (REUTERS)

Tembakan Sam Smith melebar sebelum Cacace memanfaatkan peluang pada menit ke-37 untuk melesakkan gol pertamanya bagi Wrexham dari jarak 20 yard, terbantu oleh sedikit pembelokan arah setelah mengenai tumit Morato.

Senyum kubu Wrexham semakin lebar tiga menit kemudian saat Rathbone menerobos adangan Morato untuk mencetak gol ketiganya dalam empat pertandingan.

Skor seharusnya bisa menjadi tiga gol — dan kemungkinan menyudahi perlawanan — ketika Smith berlari kencang tanpa kawalan melewati pertahanan Forest, namun gagal menaklukkan kaki Sels yang meregang untuk menghalau bola.

Manajer Forest, Sean Dyche, melakukan tiga pergantian pemain di babak pertama dengan memasukkan Williams, Morgan Gibbs-White, dan Nicolas Dominguez untuk menyelamatkan situasi.

Okonkwo menepis penalti penentu untuk menggagalkan upaya Omari Hutchinson dalam adu penalti (Martin Rickett/PA Wire)

Tim tamu langsung tampil lebih cair saat Okonkwo menepis tendangan bebas Luiz ke atas mistar dan menggagalkan tembakan Nicolo Savona.

Sels melakukan penyelamatan gemilang dari peluang Broadhead, tetapi Forest sedang berada di atas angin dan berhasil mencetak gol saat Savona memberikan umpan silang yang disambut sundulan Jesus sambil melompat, bola membentur tiang gawang dan melewati garis gawang.

Drama semakin memuncak saat Hyam menyundul umpan tendangan bebas brilian George Dobson, dan Hudson-Odoi menyarangkan bola ke gawang 60 detik kemudian untuk menciptakan akhir laga yang menegangkan.

Hudson-Odoi membawa pertandingan ke babak perpanjangan waktu dengan cara yang fantastis, mengontrol bola dengan dadanya dan melepaskan tembakan voli sempurna melewati Okonkwo, namun Wrexham tidak mau melewatkan kesempatan untuk menumbangkan tim kasta tertinggi di Piala FA untuk pertama kalinya dalam 26 tahun.

Sean Dyche melakukan delapan perubahan pada skuad Forest dan memainkan para pemain pilihan utamanya namun tetap gagal meraih kemenangan (Martin Rickett/PA Wire)

Di pertandingan Piala FA lainnya, Oxford United melaju ke babak keempat berkat kemenangan adu penalti 4-3 atas MK Dons, dan Port Vale mengalahkan Fleetwood 1-0.

Forest melakukan delapan perubahan setelah mengalahkan West Ham pada hari Selasa, dengan kiper Matz Sels, Jesus, dan Hutchinson tetap dipertahankan, sementara pemain internasional Wales Neco Williams berada di bangku cadangan klub masa kecilnya.

Forest memulai laga dengan menekan lewat tembakan Jesus yang melambung di atas gawang, dan Douglas Luiz berhasil membobol gawang setelah 17 menit pertandingan berjalan.

Wasit Paul Tierney awalnya mengesahkan gol tersebut, namun kemudian menganulirnya setelah memutuskan bahwa Luiz telah mengontrol bola dengan tangannya sebelum melepaskan tembakan voli.

source_doc:
Campanīle
A #poetry thread
i.
A Roman church belfry,
gold cross reaching for clouds:
bell tolls, sets brass note free,
sings out through misty shroud,
its high peal an appeal
to the faithful long gone.
No more piety’s zeal:
many sunsetted dawns.
Its stone tower keeps watch
through the mask of dusk-rain,
skies loosing their barrage
upon roof tiles again.
🧵👇🏼
#poem #poemaday #moody #neoclassical #church #night #photography

ii.
Who pulled on the bell cord?
Lone monk in his cloister
with none left in accord.
He, grain in church oyster —
yet no cell holds his bed,
no dust stirred by his shoes,
his name never was said,
no old books that he used.
The bell rope hangs, worn, frayed,
gnawed by church mice’s teeth.
It’s been long since it swayed,
pulled by hands underneath.
🧵👇🏼

iii.
The night wind whispers psalms
and breathes canticles’ chant
to swing the clapper of bronze,
I answer in descant —
but not with my own voice.
The wind swallows my call,
chimes its own holy noise
with the hands of its squall.
✋🏼🧵
