Sebuah thread #puisi
i.
Menara lonceng gereja Romawi,
salib emas menggapai awan:
lonceng berdentang, melepas nada kuningan,
berkumandang menembus selubung berkabut,
denting tingginya jadi panggilan
bagi umat setia yang telah lama tiada.
Tak ada lagi gairah kesalehan:
terlalu banyak fajar yang telah jadi senja.
Menara batunya tetap berjaga
di balik topeng hujan-senja,
langit kembali menumpahkan gempurannya
di atas genting atap.
🧵👇🏼
#puisi #puisiharian #sendu #neoklasik #gereja #malam #fotografi

ii.
Siapa yang menarik tali lonceng itu?
Seorang rahib sendirian di biaranya,
saat tak ada lagi yang seirama.
Dia, sebutir pasir dalam tiram gereja —
namun tak ada sel yang menyimpan ranjangnya,
tak ada debu terusik oleh sepatunya,
namanya tak pernah terucap,
tak ada buku tua yang pernah dipakainya.
Tali lonceng itu menggantung, usang, terurai,
digerogoti gigi tikus-tikus gereja.
Sudah lama sejak ia pernah berayun,
ditarik oleh tangan-tangan dari bawah.
🧵👇🏼

Angin malam membisikkan mazmur
dan mengembuskan lantunan kidung
untuk mengayunkan pemukul perunggu,
aku menjawab dengan descant —
tapi bukan dengan suaraku sendiri.
Angin menelan panggilanku,
mendentingkan riuh kudusnya sendiri
dengan tangan-tangan badai liarnya.
✋🏼🧵

$partner has a video consult with Ikea to quote for a fitted kitchen. It's a fascinating glimpse into the ecosystem of online services for boomers.
1. They send link for video consult, three weeks ago. It uses Ikea's proprietary videoconf solution
2. They request the designs & 3D renders for the new kitchen
3. they send an email saying "thanks for sending through the design
4. We dial in today, they start the call with "our system blocked your files, let's design your kitchen together"
1/x

5. Partner asks if there's any way to share the (very detailed, took us like a full man week to put together) designs, but the Ikea salesdrone is on a script, and isn't having a bar of it.
6. The next step in the script is "laboriously do the design from scratch over the phone with the client, hunting and pecking on the keyboard and not fast using the UI of their design software"
2/x

7. They cannot share their screen, so it's a clown show of repeated misunderstanding about which part of which image is being referred to

8. the clock has just ticked past what should have been the full consult, and they're 35% the way thru getting the required measurements.

9. So far there's been literally 8 minutes of salesdrone laboriously inputting the measurements supplied

My brother in He-Who-Shall-Not-Be-Named, what you are describing is a consequence of _misogyny_, not "misandry."

I desperately need men to realize that just because it's directed at them and an actual serious problem doesn't mean it is "misandry."
Just saw someone describe being discriminated against _for being considered effeminate_ as "misandry" and I just.

It's not that you aren't experiencing something real. You very well may be. But it isn't "misandry." Because "misandry" doesn't exist.
Yes, this applies to trans men as well. "Transmisandry" _also_ isn't a thing and just contributes to anti-feminist narratives. It treats itself as a mirror of transmisogyny, but transmisogyny is _intersective_: we experience transphobia _and_ we experience misogyny _and_ we experience this unholy thing that happens when the two interact. It's not a subset, even an exclusive subset, it's an intersection.
But the following all are absolutely problems that can be talked about!
* Transphobia/Transmisia
* Antitransmasculity
* Transemasculation
* Misogyny
It sucks to be discriminated against, but the language that we use is so, so important here.

Gue butuh banget para cowok sadar kalau cuma karena hal itu ditujukan ke mereka dan emang masalah serius, bukan berarti itu "misandri".
Baru aja ngeliat ada yang nyebut diskriminasi _karena dianggap kemayu_ sebagai "misandri" dan gue bener-bener... ah sudahlah.

source_doc:
Today's Sunday Best features my Knight from Ragnarok Online! This was my very first online PC game, he was an agi/dex 2HQ knight w/ a set of elemental claymores. I played on iRO Loki, and had two drawings featured as loadscreen art!
My online handle stems from this guy. O'Reiley -> Reiley -> Rally

Coming in just under the wire on today's Sunday Best, it's my Deep Rock Galactic Engineer! The loadout I ran most of the time was Executioner LOK-1 & RJ-250 Grenade Launcher. I think the LOK-1 is one of the coolest weapon designs in an FPS, a lock-on mechanic that encouraged finesse & deep mastery.

This week's Sunday Best is my Xenoverse OC, Parma (for parmesan cheese). She had a partner named Brie. Parma dressed up to match the teachers she studied under, but her final fit reflected the one she started with, styled to match this one pair of gloves. She used Giant Storm & Double Sunday a lot.

For my Sunday Best I drew my Paxultek from Remnant II. The goal of my build was to make the damage number from a single shot as large as possible. I used a Widowmaker single-shot elephant rifle we nicknamed The Governor. It was so strong it one-shot teammates through friendly fire damage reduction.

Today's Sunday Best features my funny gay dog lady from Webfishing. Her voice had a deeper, slower pitch so she sounded old & chill. One time I joined a full server, sat somewhere & started posting practical life advice, bits of big-sister wisdom, & the whole server found me & sat with me to listen.

It's Sunday, today's feature is my Darktide Zealot. Her name is Callista, she's chasing sainthood to be pardoned of her many crimes so she won't have to apologize for any of them. She has black dreams full of teeth and is constantly flirting with female Loner Psykers. She's unwell, but Female Loose Cannon Veterans think it's endearing and constantly hit on her for it. Their in-game voices say all of this.

Today's Sunday Best feature is QP from 100% Orange Juice! I played OJ a lot with my fighting game friends; for some reason I'd always have the hand pictured here. We used to post in text chat during games and I'd always say, Do NOT test me. I played so much QP the devs awarded me a special QP badge!

This week's Sunday Best is "Local Psychopath," Fem Boss #1 from Saint's Row 3. This was the first game I wanted to use the create-a-feature to make a character who blended in with the cast and looked like a genuine member of the Third Street Saints. I picked 3 cuz my favorite jacket wasn't in 4. :(

For today's Sunday Best I've got my Animal Crossing Villager to share. My favorite way to play these games is as part of a global cartel of goons who shared their wealth. When one person had big Turnips, everyone got paid. No profiteering; you need a rare item to make your room idea work? We got you.

It's technically Sunday, and this week's fit lands a bit early! I don't Tekken very often, but when I do I like to pick Steve and do all his slippery punches. In Tekken 7 he had a loose-fit, full-body track suit, so I made him into a deer man. When he's in Peekaboo Stance the antlers point forward!

This week's Sunday Best feature is Gaige from Borderlands 2. Pure Anarchy is one of the coolest FPS mechanics in the genre, an escalating accumulation of power that came with a diminishing level of control, lowering both TTK & effective range. Ride the wave & figure it out on the fly, it'll be fine.
Gaige's voice actress plays V in Cyberpunk 2077, I learned recently. An old friend.

Today's Sunday Best isn't a person, it's a plane from an old Vlambeer game called Luftrausers! The music changes to match your airplane. My favorite configuration is called "Shipwreck," a sword-hulled amphibious prop plane with shotgun cannons, it can divebomb through boats & burst up from the sea.

Tonight our Sunday Best feature is the Houndmaster from a charming Crawl-like sidescroller called Vagante. Lovingly referred to as the Dogmancer, I loved to spec into skills that increased damage when you threw the dog at monsters. The dog roams on its own, but you can also carry it on your back!

For this week's Sunday Best we're going all the way back to Cyborg Justice on the Genesis. I played this game a lot and I always liked to make this one guy: round torso, big stampy feet and the buzzsaw hand. I always remember the magazine ad for this game vividly; you might too if you're of an age.

I did a bit of archaeological research to uncover references for this week's Sunday Best. This was my guy from Loadout, a third-person arena shooter about fiddly weapon customization. My main gun was an electric pulse cannon called "Kill-a-Watts" and the backup was a flaming LMG named "Roast Beef."

Sunday Best hari ini nampilin Knight-ku dari Ragnarok Online! Ini game PC online pertamaku banget, dia tipe agi/dex 2HQ knight dengan set claymore elemen. Aku main di iRO Loki, dan ada dua gambarku yang sempat dipajang jadi art loading screen!
Username online-ku berasal dari karakter ini. O'Reiley -> Reiley -> Rally

Hampir aja kelewat buat Sunday Best hari ini, ini dia Deep Rock Galactic Engineer-ku! Loadout yang paling sering kupakai itu Executioner LOK-1 & RJ-250 Grenade Launcher. Menurutku LOK-1 itu salah satu desain senjata paling keren di game FPS, mekanik lock-on yang butuh keahlian & penguasaan mendalam.

Sunday Best minggu ini adalah OC Xenoverse-ku, Parma (dari keju parmesan). Dia punya partner namanya Brie. Parma dandan biar mirip sama guru-guru tempat dia belajar, tapi setelan terakhirnya balik lagi kayak setelan awal dia, dicocokin sama sepasang sarung tangan ini. Dia sering banget pakai Giant Storm & Double Sunday.

Untuk Sunday Best-ku, aku ngegambar Paxultek-ku dari Remnant II. Target build-ku adalah bikin angka damage dari satu tembakan segede mungkin. Aku pakai senapan gajah satu tembakan Widowmaker yang kami kasih julukan The Governor. Saking kuatnya, senapan ini bisa langsung nge-kill temen sendiri meskipun udah ada pengurangan damage friendly fire.

Sunday Best hari ini nampilin mbak-mbak anjing gay yang lucu dari Webfishing. Suaranya agak nge-bass dan lambat, jadi kedengerannya tua & santai. Pernah sekali waktu aku masuk ke server yang penuh, duduk di suatu tempat & mulai ngebagiin saran hidup yang praktis, wejangan ala kakak perempuan, & seisi server langsung nyamperin aku & duduk bareng buat dengerin.

Udah hari Minggu, tampilan hari ini adalah Zealot Darktide-ku. Namanya Callista, dia lagi ngejar gelar santa biar diampuni dari dosa-dosanya yang segudang, jadi dia gak perlu minta maaf atas semua itu. Dia punya mimpi buruk yang gelap dan penuh gigi, dan kerjaannya ngegodain Psyker Loner cewek terus. Dia emang rada gak beres, tapi Veteran Loose Cannon cewek malah ngeliat itu lucu dan sering ngegodain dia balik. Voice line mereka di dalam game ngomongin semua hal ini.

Tampilan Sunday Best hari ini adalah QP dari 100% Orange Juice! Aku sering banget main OJ bareng temen-temen game fighting-ku; entah kenapa aku selalu dapet kartu yang digambar di sini. Kami biasa chat pas lagi main dan aku selalu bilang, "JANGAN macem-macem sama aku." Saking seringnya aku main QP, developer-nya sampai ngasih aku lencana QP khusus!

Sunday Best minggu ini adalah si "Psikopat Lokal," Bos Cewek #1 dari Saint's Row 3. Ini game pertama yang bikin aku pengen pakai fitur kustomisasi buat bikin karakter yang bisa ngebaur sama karakter lain dan keliatan kayak anggota asli Third Street Saints. Aku milih seri ke-3 karena jaket favoritku gak ada di seri ke-4. :(

Buat Sunday Best hari ini, aku mau pamer Penduduk Animal Crossing-ku. Cara favoritku buat main game ini adalah jadi bagian dari kartel global para kroco yang suka bagi-bagi kekayaan. Pas ada satu orang yang dapet lobak gede, semuanya kecipratan duit. Gak ada yang cari untung sendiri; butuh barang langka biar dekorasi kamarmu makin kece? Tenang, bakal kami bantu.

Secara teknis udah hari Minggu, dan setelan minggu ini rilis agak cepet! Aku gak sering main Tekken, tapi kalau lagi main, aku suka milih Steve dan pakai semua pukulan liciknya. Di Tekken 7 dia pakai track suit longgar yang nutupin seluruh tubuh, jadi aku ubah dia jadi manusia rusa. Pas dia lagi pakai Peekaboo Stance, tanduknya bakal ngarah ke depan!

Tampilan Sunday Best minggu ini adalah Gaige dari Borderlands 2. Pure Anarchy adalah salah satu mekanik FPS paling keren di genre ini, peningkatan kekuatan yang diiringi dengan berkurangnya kontrol, yang nurunin TTK & jarak efektif senjata. Nikmatin aja prosesnya & atur strategi sambil jalan, semua bakal aman-aman aja.
Pengisi suara Gaige ternyata ngisi suara V di Cyberpunk 2077, aku baru tahu baru-baru ini. Teman lama.

Sunday Best hari ini bukan karakter orang, melainkan pesawat dari game lawas Vlambeer yang namanya Luftrausers! Musiknya bakal berubah ngikutin pesawatmu. Konfigurasi favoritku namanya "Shipwreck," pesawat baling-baling amfibi berbadan pedang dengan meriam shotgun, pesawat ini bisa nge-dive bom kapal-kapal & melesat keluar dari laut.

Malam ini tampilan Sunday Best kita adalah Houndmaster dari game sidescroller mirip Crawl yang menawan berjudul Vagante. Sering dipanggil sayang dengan sebutan Dogmancer, aku suka banget naikin skill yang nambahin damage pas kita ngelempar si anjing ke monster. Anjingnya bisa jalan-jalan sendiri, tapi bisa juga kamu gendong di punggung!

Untuk Sunday Best minggu ini, kita bakal nostalgia jauh ke belakang ke game Cyborg Justice di Sega Genesis. Aku sering banget main game ini dan selalu suka bikin karakter satu ini: badan bulat, kaki besar yang mantap, dan tangan gergaji mesin. Aku masih inget jelas banget iklan majalah buat game ini; kamu juga mungkin inget kalau seumuran denganku.

Aku sempat ngelakuin sedikit riset arkeologi buat nyari referensi Sunday Best minggu ini. Ini karakterku dari Loadout, game third-person arena shooter tentang kustomisasi senjata yang rumit. Senjata utamaku adalah meriam pulsa listrik bernama "Kill-a-Watts" dan senjata cadangannya adalah LMG api bernama "Roast Beef."

source_doc:
:redpanda: sometimes people will ask us like "what if you got a publisher for [game] wouldn't that be wicked?" but the problem is that all that would have to go through our game director, Ashe, who's said she wont speak to any publisher who doesn't address her as Ashe
the second she gets "Jess" the deal ends

:redpanda: and in a world where like, not even the AI slop publishers sending AI emails, but the people who have been flat out rude and some of them like, you could *feel* the misogyny dripping off their email, we're not really interested in talking to any of them lol

:redpanda: (I will shout out the publishers who have reached out to us though who have been like "here's some of the games we've published" and, out of their catalog, they picked out exclusively furry games. at least they did their homework)

:redpanda: anyways if you ever were like "I don't understand why Blobun isn't on switch? it'd be a perfect fit" that's why, and we can't afford the devkit and version of gamemaker that does that export, so yea you gotta go steam deck (or x86-ARM converter on those anbernics) if you want it on the go

source_doc:
Melbourne Renegades host Glenn Maxwell and the Melbourne Stars at Marvel Stadium in BBL15 after Usman Khawaja and Brisbane Heat host Sydney Thunder

Sam Harper dominated with 82 not out off 51 balls and Glenn Maxwell recalled the feeling of ball on bat in a subdued innings of 20 not out off 17 balls, which included one massive six. He has not lost his ability and would have enjoyed the chance to spend time in the middle.

The crowd of 42,846 was not given the contest they hoped for as the Stars won the match by eight wickets with 25 balls remaining.

It keeps Melbourne Stars in contention as they break a three-match losing sequence and makes life hard for Melbourne Renegades. Marcus Stoinis bowled well to take 3-33 and was on a hat-trick at one stage while Harper is in great form having hit 356 runs at a strike rate of 159 for the tournament. He was man-of-the-match.

Tom Rogers bounced back with a fast 50 against Melbourne Renegades

But it was all over once Tom Rogers helped himself to 50 off 19 balls to start the innings with an opening partnership of 84 with Harper.

"They outplayed us at the "G so it was nice to get our fifth win," Harper told Fox Cricket.

Most interesting were the comments from the Fox Cricket commentary box where former England captain Michael Vaughan made it clear how disappointed he was with the way the English hierarchy handled a nightclub incident involving Harry Brook in New Zealand before they arrived in Australia for The Ashes.

Melbourne Stars veteran Peter Siddle said "it was a good turnaround" with the win pushing the team back into second spot on the BBL table.

It's starting to heat up with three games remaining for Melbourne Renegades and two matches for Melbourne Stars.

There is still plenty of cricket left this summer so keep tuning in. Thanks for following. Can the Stars finally win the title?

hypothesis:
Melbourne Renegades menjamu Glenn Maxwell dan Melbourne Stars di Marvel Stadium dalam ajang BBL15 setelah Usman Khawaja dan Brisbane Heat menjamu Sydney Thunder

Sam Harper tampil mendominasi dengan mencetak 82 run tanpa keluar dari 51 bola, sementara Glenn Maxwell kembali menemukan sentuhan terbaiknya lewat pukulan yang tenang untuk menghasilkan 20 run tanpa keluar dari 17 bola, termasuk satu pukulan enam angka yang sangat jauh. Ia belum kehilangan kemampuannya dan tampak menikmati kesempatan untuk bermain di tengah lapangan.

Sebanyak 42.846 penonton yang hadir tidak mendapatkan laga sengit yang mereka harapkan karena Stars memenangkan pertandingan dengan keunggulan delapan wicket dan 25 bola tersisa.

Hasil ini menjaga peluang Melbourne Stars sekaligus menghentikan tren negatif tiga kekalahan beruntun, serta mempersulit posisi Melbourne Renegades. Marcus Stoinis melakukan lemparan dengan sangat baik untuk meraih catatan 3-33 dan sempat berpeluang mencetak hat-trick, sementara Harper sedang dalam performa terbaiknya setelah mengemas 356 run dengan strike rate 159 di sepanjang turnamen. Ia pun dinobatkan sebagai pemain terbaik dalam pertandingan ini.

Tom Rogers bangkit kembali dengan mencetak 50 run cepat saat melawan Melbourne Renegades

Namun, pertandingan praktis usai setelah Tom Rogers dengan mudah mencetak 50 run dari 19 bola untuk memulai giliran memukul, lewat kemitraan pembuka sebanyak 84 run bersama Harper.

"Mereka mengalahkan kami di 'G (MCG), jadi sangat menyenangkan bisa mengamankan kemenangan kelima kami," ujar Harper kepada Fox Cricket.

Hal yang paling menarik perhatian adalah komentar dari bilik siaran Fox Cricket, tempat mantan kapten Inggris, Michael Vaughan, menyatakan dengan jelas kekecewaannya atas cara jajaran manajemen kriket Inggris menangani insiden klub malam yang melibatkan Harry Brook di Selandia Baru, sebelum mereka tiba di Australia untuk ajang The Ashes.

Pemain veteran Melbourne Stars, Peter Siddle, mengatakan "ini adalah kebangkitan yang bagus" karena kemenangan ini berhasil mendongkrak posisi tim kembali ke peringkat kedua klasemen BBL.

Persaingan kini mulai memanas dengan tiga pertandingan tersisa bagi Melbourne Renegades dan dua pertandingan untuk Melbourne Stars.

Masih banyak pertandingan kriket menarik yang akan tersaji di sisa musim panas ini, jadi terus pantau perkembangannya. Terima kasih telah mengikuti. Akankah Stars akhirnya keluar sebagai juara?

Relentless Clan power past Steelers in statement home win

The Clan got off to a strong start with Joe Hazeldine slamming a first-time shot into the Sheffield net after some nice slip passing between Hugo Roy and Deven Sideroff.

Despite some strong defensive play from Glasgow, the Steelers found a breakthrough via Brien Diffley's sharp shooting through traffic before Mikko Juusola gave the visitors the lead with a deflected shot from right wing.

In the second period, the Clan saw momentum swing their way with Steven Seigo slipping a tidy finish from close-range past Matthew Greenfield to tie the game up.

Shortly after, Rylan Schwartz grabbed a go-ahead goal with a bullet from the backdoor after some luck with the Clan avoiding a too many men call.

Sheffield forced their way back into the game with Ryan Tait driving on net and backhanding a shot which Brine saved but didn't keep hold of as Kevin Tansey poked a third goal over the line for the visitors.

With the score line tied going into the final frame, the noise peaked inside Braehead and Glasgow gained control of the game.

Tristin Langan saw retribution for the ongoing battle he had to put up with throughout the game with Mitchell Heard as he cracked the bar with a beautiful finish to give his side the lead.

A holding penalty on Miihkali Teppo applied pressure to the hosts' advantage late on with the Steelers pulling their netminder for the extra attacker.

Langan grabbed his second of the game on the empty net though to round off the night with a well-earned and much-needed two points for the Clan on home ice.

Glasgow Clan head coach, Corey Neilson said after the game: "We were the better team. Our forecheck was excellent, that's something we've worked on all week and it was relentless tonight. The identity we were looking for is starting to show. It was really enjoyable to coach with full lines and take advantage of a team that's playing short, because usually we're on the other side of that."

Sheffield Steelers head coach, Aaron Fox, said: "I thought we were pretty good for the majority of the game. Glasgow jumped on us early, but our bounce back was good. Our guys were gassed by the end, we only had three lines but we were in the battle all game, I can't fault the compete level of our guys."

Clan memulai pertandingan dengan kuat setelah Joe Hazeldine menyambar umpan dengan tembakan langsung ke gawang Sheffield, memanfaatkan kerja sama apik antara Hugo Roy dan Deven Sideroff.

Meskipun pertahanan Glasgow tampil solid, Steelers berhasil menemukan celah lewat tembakan akurat Brien Diffley di tengah kerumunan pemain sebelum Mikko Juusola membawa tim tamu unggul melalui tembakan yang terbelokkan dari sayap kanan.

Di periode kedua, Clan berhasil merebut kembali momentum pertandingan saat Steven Seigo melepaskan penyelesaian rapi dari jarak dekat melewati Matthew Greenfield untuk menyamakan kedudukan.

Tidak lama setelah itu, Rylan Schwartz membawa timnya berbalik unggul lewat tembakan keras dari tiang jauh, setelah Clan sedikit beruntung terhindar dari hukuman akibat kelebihan pemain di lapangan.

Sheffield berjuang keras untuk kembali ke permainan ketika Ryan Tait menusuk ke arah gawang dan melepaskan tembakan backhand yang sempat dihalau Brine namun tidak dapat diamankan, sehingga Kevin Tansey berhasil menyontek gol ketiga tim tamu melewati garis gawang.

Dengan skor imbang memasuki periode penentu, gemuruh penonton di dalam Braehead mencapai puncaknya dan Glasgow berhasil memegang kendali permainan.

Tristin Langan membalas tuntas duel sengit yang harus ia hadapi sepanjang pertandingan melawan Mitchell Heard, dengan melepaskan tembakan indah yang membentur mistar gawang untuk membawa timnya memimpin.

Hukuman penalti akibat holding yang diterima Miihkali Teppo sempat memberikan tekanan bagi keunggulan tuan rumah di menit-menit akhir, saat Steelers menarik keluar penjaga gawang mereka demi menambah pemain menyerang.

Namun, Langan berhasil mencetak gol keduanya malam itu ke gawang yang kosong untuk menutup pertandingan, sekaligus mengamankan dua poin berharga yang sangat dibutuhkan Clan di kandang sendiri.

Kepala pelatih Glasgow Clan, Corey Neilson, mengatakan setelah pertandingan: "Kami adalah tim yang lebih baik. Forecheck kami sangat luar biasa, itu adalah sesuatu yang kami latih sepanjang minggu ini dan malam ini kami bermain tanpa ampun. Identitas permainan yang kami cari mulai terlihat. Sangat menyenangkan bisa melatih dengan skuad yang lengkap dan memanfaatkan lawan yang kekurangan pemain, karena biasanya kamilah yang berada di posisi sulit tersebut."

Kepala pelatih Sheffield Steelers, Aaron Fox, mengatakan: "Saya rasa kami bermain cukup baik di sebagian besar pertandingan. Glasgow langsung menekan kami sejak awal, tetapi respons kami sangat bagus. Para pemain kami kelelahan di akhir laga, kami hanya memiliki tiga barisan pemain tetapi kami terus berjuang sepanjang pertandingan. Saya tidak bisa menyalahkan tingkat kerja keras para pemain kami."

source_doc:
Ate a little more chicken and had a wash. Also had a little more fight when I made her take her fluids last.
We phoned the vet at 830 this morning to ask if they looked under her soft pallet while she was sedated, as she has major ear polyps. Was told the vet would call back. They didn't, rang just now (1645 local) and was told the vet wasn't in today. I was a bit annoyed and said "we paid you over £600 yesterday, you said phone if we have questions, we have questions you're not answering!"
"I don't like your tone, sir "
"It's not your fault personally, but when I pay the better part of a grand I expect a level of service that you're not providing"
"I'll get a vet from the other branch to ring you"

Seeing vet at other practise at half seven for more anti nausea medicine. They're not going to charge out of hours rate as we rang first thing.
Just got another 10ml of rescue fluids into her.

Back. Anti nausea jab, gabapentin, and she's home. Ate some chicken and some cheese.
Got more gabapentin in pill form for her, too

Won't stop eating. Having to slow her down to prevent her from vomiting. She's also absolutely, completely, totally, off her tits. Mullered. Stoned. Caned. Fully in the yellow submarine.
Vet says this'll reset her appetite, or, when we stop giving her painkillers, show it's pain stopping her eating, which would mean medical imaging time.

She's eating a bit, and even played a little, but she's still on the medications so it might be that. Still giving her recovery fluids, which she's still not fighting as she would normally.

Valencia has decided we are all Suspicious. Won't come when called, runs if you go to her. Still comes on her own terms, so it's fine, she's just seen her adoptive sister repeatedly wrapped in a towel and made to drink Stuff, and she wants none of that, thank you very much.

Ming update: she's a little more active, but still floppy and sleeping a lot. She's on two lots of painkillers still, so she's probably fairly stoned.
She IS eating, little and often, and finished off the last of her rescue fluids from a saucer by herself. She's washing, but she hasn't slapped valencia in ages, and she's still not right. Hoping it's the painkillers, and that when we withdraw them, her appetite remains.

Ming has finished the course of painkillers and is showing determined desire to go out, which we're not allowing yet. She's eating, playing, but it'll be a few days until the drugs are cleared from her system and we'll then see how she is.
Cautiously optimistic.

Udah makan ayam lagi dikit terus jilat-jilat badan. Terus juga agak ngelawan pas terakhir dicekokin cairan.
Kita telepon dokter hewan jam 8.30 pagi ini buat nanya apa mereka meriksa bagian bawah langit-langit lunak mulutnya pas dia dibius, soalnya dia punya polip telinga yang lumayan parah. Katanya dokter bakal telepon balik. Tapi enggak ditelepon-telepon, pas barusan ditelepon lagi (jam 16.45 waktu setempat) katanya dokternya enggak masuk hari ini. Agak kesel dong, langsung aja dibilang "kemarin kami bayar lebih dari £600, katanya telepon aja kalau ada pertanyaan, sekarang kami mau nanya tapi enggak dijawab!"
"Saya enggak suka dengan nada bicara Anda, Pak"
"Ini memang bukan salah Anda pribadi, tapi kalau saya sudah bayar hampir seribu pound, saya ekspektasi dapet pelayanan yang sepadan, dan kalian enggak ngasih itu"
"Saya bakal minta dokter hewan dari cabang lain buat telepon Bapak"

Nanti jam setengah delapan malam mau ketemu dokter hewan di klinik cabang lain buat minta obat anti-mual tambahan. Mereka enggak bakal ngecas tarif luar jam kerja karena kita udah telepon dari pagi-pagi buta.
Baru aja berhasil nyuapin 10ml cairan pemulihan lagi ke dia.

Udah balik. Udah disuntik anti-mual, dikasih gabapentin, dan sekarang dia udah di rumah. Sempat makan ayam sama keju sedikit.
Dapet tambahan gabapentin yang bentuk pil juga buat dia.

Makan mulu enggak mau berhenti. Terpaksa musti direm biar dia enggak muntah. Dia juga bener-bener, asli, teler banget. Mabok. Ngefly. Pokoknya lagi di awang-awang deh.
Kata dokter ini bakal balikin nafsu makannya, atau, pas kita setop kasih obat pereda nyeri nanti, bakal ketahuan apa rasa sakit yang bikin dia enggak mau makan, yang artinya harus discan.

Dia udah mau makan dikit-dikit, bahkan sempat main sebentar, tapi karena masih di bawah pengaruh obat jadi mungkin karena itu. Masih terus dicekokin cairan pemulihan, dan dia masih belum ngelawan kayak biasanya.

Valencia lagi curigaan banget sama kita semua. Dipanggil enggak mau nyamperin, dideketin malah kabur. Tapi kalau emang lagi pengen ya bakal nyamperin sendiri sih, jadi ya sudahlah. Dia cuma parno aja abis ngeliat saudara angkatnya berkali-kali dibuntel handuk terus dipaksa minum sesuatu, dan dia ogah banget digituin juga, makasih banyak.

Kabar terbaru Ming: dia udah agak aktifan, tapi masih lemas dan banyak tidur. Dia masih minum dua jenis obat pereda nyeri, jadi ya wajar kalau masih agak teler.
Dia MAU makan, porsi kecil tapi sering, dan bahkan ngabisin sisa cairan pemulihannya sendiri dari lepek. Dia sempat jilat-jilat badan, tapi udah lama banget enggak ngegampar Valencia, jadi dia emang belum pulih bener. Semoga aja ini karena efek obat pereda nyeri, dan pas obatnya dihentikan, nafsu makannya tetap bagus.

Ming udah kelar minum semua obat pereda nyerinya dan kelihatan ngebet banget pengen keluar rumah, tapi masih belum kita bolehkan. Dia udah mau makan, main, tapi butuh beberapa hari sampai sisa obatnya benar-benar hilang dari tubuhnya baru kita bisa lihat kondisinya yang sebenarnya.
Optimis tapi tetap waspada.

Falkirk strengthen top six hopes with away win at St Mirren

Miller then made sure of the points just after the hour mark as he capitalised on some static St Mirren defending to race on to his own blocked shot before dinking the ball over George.

It was an afternoon to forget for St Mirren, who lost Liam Donnelly, Killian Phillips and George to injury as they slipped to a third straight defeat.

Falkirk had the first opening in the 18th minute when Barney Stewart laid the ball off to Dylan Tait, whose curling effort from just outside the box took a slight deflection before cannoning off the top of the crossbar.

St Mirren finally threatened just after the half-hour mark when Mikael Mandron shot from a tight angle, forcing Falkirk goalkeeper Scott Bain into a smart stop with his feet.

Falkirk then raced down the other end and the lively Miller was released and allowed to shoot from a similar angle but George comfortably saved.

The match was finally coming to life and Dan Nlundulu was the next to fire at goal in the 36th minute after the Bairns had given up possession cheaply, but it was a routine stop at the near post by Bain.

Nlundulu then got in behind and slid the ball home, though the cheers from the home fans were short-lived as the assistant referee raised his flag for what appeared to be a clear offside.

The hosts had already lost Donnelly to injury midway through the first half and they suffered a further blow when Phillips, who appeared to hurt his shoulder in the opening period, came off at the interval.

The match was crying out for a moment of quality and it came 10 minutes into the second half through Yeats.

Tait's perfect through ball released Miller, and although George came racing out of his goal and timed his challenge well, the loose ball fell invitingly for Yeats, who curled a stunning first-time finish into the top corner of the unguarded St Mirren goal.

It got even better for the away side just after the hour mark as the Bairns doubled their lead.

Miller's initial shot from the edge of the box was blocked by Scott Tanser but, as the home defence hesitated, Miller reacted first to run on to the loose ball and lift a right-footed shot over the onrushing George.

St Mirren suffered yet another blow shortly after as the keeper was forced off to be replaced by Ryan Mullen.

The enforced changes and the quickfire goals seemed to rock the hosts and they never threatened a comeback, with their afternoon summed up in the 89th minute when Tanser completely mis-kicked his attempted volley from six yards out.

source_doc:
And being one of the weirdo, we just frequently get attacks here and there. Either online, offline, or even from your closest people. Those attacks usually stem from homophobia, transphobia, or sometimes just, don't like how weird we are and how weird we act, especially furries that do deeper immersions like roleplaying and therianthropy.

Hence some of us got safety by not needing to tell who we are and where we were from. Some of us got safety by only revealing ourselves to our friends or close friends. Face/body reveal is a culture that most of the furries did at least once in a private post, whether it be "delete soon" kind of post or in story.

Despite being so, we're still open for social interactions offline. We do furmeets—a personal meeting between furries, be it in a group or personal, be it in an event or just casually—and sometimes making a con/fur on, such as MWFF, IWAG, PAWAI, FURUM, and so on. It's fun to meet them offline, get to know each other, be able to see them in person as most of us have never seen each other's faces, take a photo to keep personally and censor publicly, laugh together and discuss similar interests, and so on. It's fun, social, and warm.

Although, things don't feel the same today. As people start trying to strip anonymity of people, attack furries, therian, LGBTQIA, and dox them, as how also our community participate and stir the dramas inside, things has been a little more chaotic, less warm, and less feeling like community or family. It's not the same anymore.

Part of me hopes things can return to how it feels in the 2000s and 2010s, but, I'll just let God do the rest. I'm a little hopeless in society and humans. I'm tired of how things get worse and meant to attack and divide small communities into a hopeless being. I don't like how society is now no longer respecting and being in unity.

hypothesis:
Dan sebagai salah satu orang yang dianggap aneh, kami memang sering kena serangan dari berbagai arah. Entah online, offline, atau bahkan dari orang-orang terdekat sendiri. Serangan-serangan itu biasanya berakar dari homofobia, transfobia, atau kadang ya cuma karena mereka nggak suka sama betapa anehnya kami dan cara kami berperilaku, terutama furry yang lebih mendalami hal-hal kayak roleplay dan therianthropy.

Makanya, beberapa dari kami merasa lebih aman kalau nggak perlu bilang siapa kami dan kami berasal dari mana. Ada juga yang merasa aman dengan cuma membuka diri ke teman atau sahabat dekat. Face/body reveal itu udah jadi semacam budaya yang kebanyakan furry setidaknya pernah lakuin sekali lewat postingan privat, entah itu postingan model "hapus nanti" atau di story.

Meski begitu, kami tetap terbuka buat interaksi sosial secara offline. Kami ngadain furmeet—pertemuan langsung antar furry, baik rame-rame maupun personal, entah di acara atau cuma santai aja—dan kadang juga bikin con/furcon, seperti MWFF, IWAG, PAWAI, FURUM, dan lain-lain. Seru banget bisa ketemu mereka langsung, saling kenal lebih dekat, bisa lihat satu sama lain secara nyata karena kebanyakan dari kami belum pernah lihat wajah masing-masing, foto bareng buat disimpan pribadi lalu disensor kalau diposting ke publik, ketawa bareng, ngobrolin minat yang sama, dan sebagainya. Rasanya seru, akrab, dan hangat.

Tapi, sekarang rasanya udah nggak sama lagi. Saat orang-orang mulai berusaha ngilangin anonimitas orang lain, nyerang furry, therian, LGBTQIA, lalu nge-dox mereka, ditambah komunitas kami sendiri juga ikut terlibat dan manas-manasin drama di dalam, semuanya jadi lebih kacau, kurang hangat, dan makin nggak terasa seperti komunitas atau keluarga. Sekarang udah nggak sama lagi.

Sebagian dari diriku berharap semuanya bisa balik ke suasana kayak di tahun 2000-an dan 2010-an, tapi ya, sisanya biar Tuhan yang ngatur. Aku agak putus asa sama masyarakat dan manusia. Aku capek lihat semuanya makin memburuk dan malah dijadikan alat buat menyerang dan memecah komunitas-komunitas kecil sampai rasanya kehilangan harapan. Aku nggak suka gimana masyarakat sekarang udah nggak saling menghormati dan nggak lagi hidup dalam kebersamaan.

The amp is a Philips FA454 and the CD Player is a Philips CD150.

I take this to mean an 8 pin din to a 5 pin + stereo RCA cable...which sounds cursed.

Robin Roefs" penalty saves secures Sunderland's spot in FA Cup fourth round

Get the Adam Clery Football Column. A newsletter that unpacks the absurdities and oddities of the beautiful game

The ACFC newsletter: unpacking football's absurdities

Unpack football's oddities with the ACFC newsletter

Robin Roefs was Sunderland's hero as Everton's FA Cup hopes came to a premature end once again after three woeful penalties in a shootout saw the Black Cats reach round four.

David Moyes" threadbare squad looked like exiting in normal time until James Garner's 89th-minute spot-kick cancelled out Enzo Le Fee's brilliant first-half strike.

But extra time was the last thing the hosts, down to just 12 senior players, needed and when the shootout came around Garner, Thierno Barry and Beto all saw their efforts saved by Roefs.

Le Fee, Granit Xhaka and Luke O'Nien confidently scored their first three attempts to help Sunderland into the fourth round for only the second time in 11 seasons.

It was a hammer blow to Everton, who were dragged back into the game by Adam Aznou, a £7.8million signing from Valladolid in the summer who had not had a sniff of first-team action.

The teenager's only senior football was two appearances in the EFL Trophy back in September and October and his 86th-minute introduction for Merlin Rohl was only because Moyes had little to no option.

But the Spanish-born Moroccan showed more drive in the four minutes of regulation time than many of his battle-weary team-mates had in the preceding 86 - particularly fellow 19-year-old and summer arrival Tyler Dibling, who cost five times as much.

Within three minutes he won an admittedly soft penalty after a shoulder-to-shoulder challenge by Trai Hume allowing Garner to equalise.

Replays of the foul on the big screens at full-time enraged Xhaka, who hurled his water bottle into the turf and raged at the perceived injustice to anyone in earshot, but the Black Cats" captain was soon celebrating.

It is rare for Sunderland, promoted from the Championship last season, to be favourites in any game but the fact Regis Le Bris was able to make five changes and still have the likes of Dan Ballard, Brian Brobbey, Omar Alderete and Wilson Isidor in reserve swung the odds in their favour.

Injuries, the Africa Cup of Nations and suspensions for Michael Keane and Jack Grealish were compounded by Tim Iroegbunam's hamstring problem which took the absences to nine.

Barry, the one senior player he left out, accounted for 23 of the 27 first-team appearances among the substitutes with five of six academy players not having previously featured at all.

After Harrison Armstrong sliced wide their only first chance of the first half, Sunderland took control and should have been comfortably ahead by the interval.

Their first shot resulted in the opener - and what a goal.

Everton failed to deal with a long throw and Eliezer Mayenda teed up Le Fee to send a cushioned right-footed volley curling past Jordan Pickford.

Moyes had a face like thunder and his demeanour was not improved as Pickford clawed away a Nordi Mukiele overhead kick and tipped away, at full-stretch, Romaine Mundle's strike from distance.

Surprisingly, the Everton boss did not make the only change available to him and sacrifice one of his five midfielders for Barry at the start of the second half, but they did not come to life until Mayenda rolled an angled shot just wide with less than half an hour remaining.

Beto's appeal for a penalty for a shirt pull by Hume was waved away but referee John Brooks obliged when Aznou went down and Garner equalised.

Unfortunately for Everton their subsequent penalties were not as confident, with Barry and Beto's stuttering run-ups far from convincing, as Roefs saved all three.

Penyelamatan penalti Robin Roefs amankan tiket Sunderland ke putaran keempat Piala FA

Dapatkan Kolom Sepak Bola Adam Clery. Buletin yang mengulas absurditas dan keunikan olahraga indah ini

Buletin ACFC: mengulas absurditas sepak bola

Ulas keunikan sepak bola bersama buletin ACFC

Robin Roefs menjadi pahlawan Sunderland saat harapan Everton di Piala FA kembali kandas lebih awal setelah tiga eksekusi penalti yang buruk dalam adu penalti membuat Black Cats melaju ke putaran keempat.

Skuad minimalis asuhan David Moyes tampaknya akan tersingkir dalam waktu normal hingga eksekusi penalti James Garner pada menit ke-89 membatalkan gol indah Enzo Le Fee di babak pertama.

Namun, babak perpanjangan waktu adalah hal terakhir yang dibutuhkan oleh tuan rumah, yang hanya diperkuat 12 pemain senior, dan saat adu penalti tiba, tembakan Garner, Thierno Barry, dan Beto semuanya berhasil digagalkan oleh Roefs.

Le Fee, Granit Xhaka, dan Luke O'Nien dengan tenang mencetak gol pada tiga eksekusi pertama mereka untuk membawa Sunderland melaju ke putaran keempat untuk kedua kalinya dalam 11 musim terakhir.

Ini menjadi pukulan telak bagi Everton, yang berhasil kembali ke permainan berkat andil Adam Aznou, pemain yang direkrut seharga £7,8 juta dari Valladolid pada musim panas lalu yang sebelumnya belum pernah merasakan atmosfer tim utama.

Satu-satunya penampilan kompetitif remaja tersebut di level senior hanyalah dua laga di EFL Trophy pada bulan September dan Oktober, dan keputusannya masuk pada menit ke-86 menggantikan Merlin Rohl murni karena Moyes hampir tidak memiliki pilihan lain.

Namun, pemain Maroko kelahiran Spanyol itu menunjukkan determinasi yang lebih besar dalam empat menit waktu normal dibandingkan rekan-rekan setimnya yang kelelahan dalam 86 menit sebelumnya - terutama sesama pemain berusia 19 tahun dan rekrutan musim panas Tyler Dibling, yang berharga lima kali lipat lebih mahal.

Dalam waktu tiga menit, ia memenangi penalti yang bisa dibilang cukup ringan setelah duel bahu-membahu dengan Trai Hume, yang memungkinkan Garner menyamakan kedudukan.

Tayangan ulang pelanggaran tersebut di layar lebar stadion saat peluit akhir berbunyi memicu amarah Xhaka, yang membanting botol airnya ke lapangan dan meluapkan kekesalannya atas ketidakadilan tersebut kepada siapa pun di sekitarnya, namun kapten Black Cats itu segera merayakan kemenangan.

Sangat jarang bagi Sunderland, yang baru promosi dari Championship musim lalu, untuk menjadi favorit dalam pertandingan apa pun, tetapi fakta bahwa Regis Le Bris dapat melakukan lima perubahan dan masih memiliki pemain seperti Dan Ballard, Brian Brobbey, Omar Alderete, dan Wilson Isidor di bangku cadangan membuat peluang berbalik menguntungkan mereka.

Masalah cedera, pemanggilan ke Piala Afrika, dan skorsing untuk Michael Keane serta Jack Grealish diperparah oleh cedera hamstring Tim Iroegbunam yang membuat daftar pemain absen membengkak menjadi sembilan orang.

Barry, satu-satunya pemain senior yang ia cadangkan, menyumbang 23 dari 27 penampilan tim utama di antara para pemain cadangan, sementara lima dari enam pemain akademi belum pernah tampil sama sekali sebelumnya.

Setelah sepakan melenceng Harrison Armstrong yang menjadi satu-satunya peluang awal mereka di babak pertama, Sunderland memegang kendali penuh dan seharusnya sudah unggul nyaman sebelum jeda.

Tembakan tepat sasaran pertama mereka langsung membuahkan gol pembuka - dan itu adalah gol yang sangat indah.

Everton gagal mengantisipasi lemparan ke dalam yang jauh, dan Eliezer Mayenda memberikan umpan matang kepada Le Fee untuk melepaskan tembakan voli kaki kanan melengkung melewati Jordan Pickford.

Wajah Moyes tampak sangat geram dan ekspresinya tidak kunjung membaik saat Pickford harus meregangkan badan untuk menepis tendangan salto Nordi Mukiele serta menghalau tembakan jarak jauh Romaine Mundle.

Anehnya, manajer Everton tersebut tidak mengambil satu-satunya opsi perubahan yang tersedia baginya untuk mengorbankan salah satu dari lima gelandangnya demi memasukkan Barry di awal babak kedua, dan mereka baru mulai bangkit setelah tembakan sudut Mayenda melebar tipis saat pertandingan menyisakan kurang dari setengah jam.

Klaim penalti Beto akibat tarikan kaus oleh Hume diabaikan, namun wasit John Brooks menunjuk titik putih saat Aznou terjatuh dan Garner menyamakan kedudukan.

Sayangnya bagi Everton, eksekusi penalti mereka berikutnya tidak dilakukan dengan penuh percaya diri, di mana ancang-ancang tersendat-sendat dari Barry dan Beto jauh dari kata meyakinkan, sehingga Roefs berhasil menyelamatkan ketiganya.

I expected to love Project Hail Mary, I LOVED Project Hail Mary, it also destroyed me in a particularly unique way as the wife of a science teacher after a year of watching all science teaching be relentlessly attacked and defunded. People love this movie, which I'm sure will be a success, and they hate my wife's work and destroy her programs and want us to lose our careers. How is it possible for all this to be true at once.

She left at 7am to go teach the hands on labs that she teaches where they handle cells, where they've increased class sizes and reduced TAs, she spends more contact hours with students in lab basements than any other class on the campus. She created a program for community college transfer students to get funded jobs in labs, opening up STEM pathways for those who never would've gotten the chance. For all her above and beyond work she's demonized as "doing DEI in science" which they call illegal

But you know, I guess if she were a white male software engineer writing fanfic about science teaching.... she'd be safe.

@grimalkina the same roots are already in Hail Mary tbh. I like Andy Weir a lot and I don't think he meant it, but the whole "bureaucracy and cooperation are truly the barrier to getting things done, and when shit hits the fan we get a powerful anti-bureaucrat to forego diplomacy and strongarm everyone into doing the project, ethics or what the participants want be damned" struck me as a very American individualism power fantasy, and I would guess an American wrote it if I didn't know

@jcachada @grimalkina
For what it's worth, the book contains this passage that didn't make it to the movie.
---
“I’m curious,” I say to Stratt. “Once we launch Hail Mary. What will you do then?”
“Me?” she said. “Doesn’t matter. Once the Hail Mary launches, my authority ends. I’ll probably be put on trial by a bunch of pissed-off governments for abuse of power. Might spend the rest of my life in jail.”
“I’ll be in the cell next to you,” said Leclerc.
“Are you at all concerned about that?”
She shrugged. “We all have to make sacrifices. If I have to be the world’s whipping boy to secure our salvation, then that’s my sacrifice to make.”
---
Is she better or worse if she thinks she's sacrificing herself?

“Gue penasaran,” kata gue ke Stratt. “Begitu kita ngeluncurin Hail Mary. Apa yang bakal lo lakuin setelah itu?”
“Gue?” katanya. “Nggak masalah. Begitu Hail Mary meluncur, wewenang gue berakhir. Gue mungkin bakal diadili sama sekelompok pemerintah yang marah karena penyalahgunaan kekuasaan. Mungkin bakal ngabisin sisa hidup gue di penjara.”

“Lo nggak khawatir sama sekali tentang itu?”

US bound Thompson stars as Galway reach FBD final

California-bound Matthew Thompson lashed home 2-06 as Galway overcame Leitrim by 11 points in Tuam to book their spot in next week's FBD League decider.

2025 Young Footballer of the Year nominee Thompson will be out of action for the entirety of the league and the early part of the championship, with Padraic Joyce confirming that the Salthill-Knocknacarra players is studying in Berkeley for the upcoming semester.

He was the leading figure on a largely experimental Galway side - which also contained Cian Hernon and Kieran Molloy - as they came from three points down at half-time to beat Leitrim.

Thompson buried a goal in the top corner in the first half but the Connacht champions trailed Leitrim at the break, Killian Gaffney proving effective from placed balls, while Ryan O'Rourke and Jack Kelly also landed points.

Galway manager Padraic Joyce remonstrates with the referee over a decision

However, with Thompson converting a second half penalty, Galway eased home after the interval, with 10 different scorers overall as they ran out 2-19 to 0-14 winners.

After two rounds of the FBD League, the top two progress to next week's final, with Galway facing the winner of tomorrow's Roscommon-Mayo tie.

In Leinster, Westmeath have booked their spot in the O'Byrne Cup final after an 11-point win over Offaly in a goal-fest in Mullingar.

Waiting for them in the decider is a Kildare outfit that defeated Dublin 1-22 to 1-13.

Mark McHugh's Westmeath side advanced ahead of reigning champions Longford following a coin toss last Saturday but they impressed on the field of play on Saturday.

A brace of goals apiece from Danny McCarton and Brandon Kelly, plus another from Senan Baker, saw them run out 5-10 to 2-08 winners.

Ciaran Murphy scored two goals either side of half-time to pull the visitors back into the contest, the margin being briefly reduced to three points 11 minutes into the second half.

However, an unanswered burst of 3-02 over the next 15 minutes saw the hosts settle the contest in an emphatic manner.

Kildare found their feet in the second half against Dublin and now are one game away from a first O'Byrne Cup since 2014.

Harry O'Neill fires to the net for Kildare

Both management teams experimented in Newbridge with Dublin in particular shorn of overly familiar faces, but in the first half it seemed to matter little as they led 1-08 to 0-08 at the break.

Jamie McCarville palmed home their goal but it was Clyde Burke who caught the eye for the travelling support with some brilliant shooting that included two orange flags - the second of which was of the highest quality.

Alex Beirne was racking up the scores for the Lilywhites though and his two-point free early in the second half kick-started a run of 1-05 without reply, Harry O'Neill with the goal in the 43rd minute.

Kildare continued to turn the screw with James Harris' late two-pointer sending them on their way.

hypothesis:
Bakal Hijrah ke AS, Thompson Tampil Cemerlang Bawa Galway ke Final FBD

Matthew Thompson, yang bersiap menuju California, melesakkan 2-06 saat Galway menundukkan Leitrim dengan selisih 11 poin di Tuam untuk mengamankan tiket ke babak final Liga FBD pekan depan.

Nomine Pemain Muda Terbaik 2025, Thompson, dipastikan akan absen di sepanjang liga dan fase awal kejuaraan, setelah Padraic Joyce mengonfirmasi bahwa pemain Salthill-Knocknacarra tersebut akan menempuh studi di Berkeley pada semester mendatang.

Ia menjadi motor serangan dalam skuad eksperimental Galway—yang juga diperkuat Cian Hernon dan Kieran Molloy—saat mereka bangkit dari ketertinggalan tiga poin di babak pertama untuk mengalahkan Leitrim.

Thompson melesakkan gol ke sudut atas gawang pada babak pertama, namun sang juara Connacht tertinggal dari Leitrim saat turun minum, dengan Killian Gaffney tampil efektif melalui bola mati, sementara Ryan O'Rourke dan Jack Kelly juga menyumbang poin.

Manajer Galway, Padraic Joyce, melayangkan protes kepada wasit atas suatu keputusan

Namun, setelah Thompson sukses mengeksekusi penalti di babak kedua, Galway melenggang mulus pascajeda. Dengan kontribusi dari 10 pencetak skor berbeda, mereka akhirnya menyudahi laga dengan kemenangan 2-19 lawan 0-14.

Setelah dua putaran Liga FBD, dua tim teratas berhak melaju ke final pekan depan, di mana Galway akan menghadapi pemenang dari laga antara Roscommon dan Mayo besok.

Di Leinster, Westmeath telah memastikan tempat mereka di final Piala O'Byrne setelah menang selisih 11 poin atas Offaly dalam laga yang banjir gol di Mullingar.

Menanti mereka di laga final adalah tim Kildare yang berhasil mengandaskan Dublin dengan skor 1-22 lawan 1-13.

Skuad Westmeath asuhan Mark McHugh melaju melampaui juara bertahan Longford menyusul undian koin pada hari Sabtu lalu, namun mereka berhasil membuktikan kelayakan tersebut lewat performa impresif di lapangan pada hari Sabtu ini.

Masing-masing dua gol dari Danny McCarton dan Brandon Kelly, ditambah satu gol dari Senan Baker, memastikan kemenangan mereka dengan skor 5-10 lawan 2-08.

Ciaran Murphy mencetak dua gol sebelum dan sesudah turun minum untuk membawa tim tamu bangkit, dengan selisih skor sempat menipis menjadi tiga poin pada menit ke-11 babak kedua.

Namun, rentetan poin 3-02 tanpa balas selama 15 menit berikutnya membuat tuan rumah mengunci kemenangan dengan cara yang meyakinkan.

Kildare berhasil menemukan bentuk permainan terbaik mereka di babak kedua saat melawan Dublin, dan kini hanya berjarak satu pertandingan lagi dari trofi Piala O'Byrne pertama mereka sejak 2014.

Harry O'Neill melepaskan tembakan keras ke dalam gawang untuk Kildare

Kedua tim manajemen melakukan eksperimen di Newbridge, dengan Dublin tampil tanpa pilar-pilar utama mereka yang sudah dikenal. Namun, di babak pertama hal itu tidak terlalu berpengaruh karena mereka berhasil memimpin 1-08 lawan 0-08 saat jeda.

Jamie McCarville menceploskan gol untuk Dublin, tetapi Clyde Burke-lah yang mencuri perhatian para pendukung tim tamu lewat beberapa tembakan gemilang yang menghasilkan dua poin—dengan tembakan kedua yang berkualitas sangat tinggi.

Kendati demikian, Alex Beirne terus mendulang angka untuk tim Lilywhites dan tendangan bebas dua poinnya di awal babak kedua memicu rentetan poin 1-05 tanpa balas, sebelum disempurnakan oleh gol Harry O'Neill pada menit ke-43.

Kildare terus menekan hingga akhir laga, dan poin ganda dari James Harris di menit-menit akhir memastikan kemenangan mutlak mereka.
